news.title: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'
news.summary: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation change.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'
news.summaryTr: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation change.
news.articleText: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely' - Published Donald Trump has said "Iran militarily is effectively over", and said that there is "positive momentum" behind negotiations to end the Middle East conflict. "We're just keeping it the status quo," the US president said on Monday. "And we're doing that really at the behest of countries that are their neighbours." Trump's comments came after he met the Qatari prime minister. Qatar is a US ally in the Gulf region, and one of Iran's neighbours, which has been a key mediator in efforts to end the war. Addressing reporters in the White House press briefing room, Trump said that renewed US attacks on Iran were "highly unlikely" but that the US was "locked and loaded" should the circumstances change. Iranian officials have repeatedly expressed doubts about Trump's prior comments about resolving the conflict. This is not the first time that Trump has said the Iran war is "militarily" over, but the circumstances for him are different now. The president has hinted at de-escalation in Iran after a bruising set of midterm election results for the Republicans last week, which senior figures including Vice-President JD Vance blamed on the Iran war. Ahead of the midterms, Trump had said US forces conducted what he described as "minor strikes" on an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz. However, in an interview with 60 Minutes that aired on Sunday, the president said that he did not currently see "any reason" to escalate the conflict. Responding to a question over why he would not officially declare an end to the war, Trump said that some of the Gulf allies could still face Iranian aggression. "We have some great allies there and we have to make sure they're not hurt," he said, suggesting that the US naval blockade on Iranian ports was helping to make the region more secure. Global oil prices, which have fallen sharply since the midterms, dipped further after Trump's comments. On Tuesday afternoon in Asia, Brent crude was more than 1% lower at $91.50 (£52) while US-traded was down by 1.2% at $85.82. Trump hosted Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdul Rahman Al Thani in the Oval Office earlier on Monday, saying they had an "excellent conversation" about negotiations to end the war. In a post on X, the Qatari leader said he held "positive discussions" with Trump and Vance on "reaching a deal and bringing peace to the region". Efforts to broker a peace between Washington and Tehran have largely been held indirectly through mediators since the war first broke out following joint US-Israeli strikes in February. Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates are among the US's Gulf allies that have been hit by Iranian strikes over the course of the war, in addition to the threat of strikes that have led to major air travel disruptions in the region. Post-election recriminations over the US war in Iran are already placing pressure on members of the Trump administration. Republican congressman Thomas Massie launched a strong attack against Trump's Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Monday over the war in Iran, requesting a vote in the House of Representatives to impeach him. Trump has backed Hegseth, who says he is "not worried" about the looming impeachment threats, calling Massie's effort a "sham". While the move is unlikely to succeed with Republicans still in control of Congress until January, Democrats have expressed willingness to impeach Hegseth once the new session begins and they have control of both the House and the Senate. - Published12 hours ago - Published2 days ago

news.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
news.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

items.titleTr: Civil servant who secretly held five jobs found guilty of fraud
items.summaryTr: Kashim Chowdhury had secretly held multiple public sector jobs on full-time salaries.
items.articleText: Civil servant who secretly held five jobs found guilty of fraud - Published A civil servant who secretly held multiple public sector jobs on full-time salaries has been found guilty of nine counts of fraud. Kashim Chowdhury, from east London, had five government jobs that overlapped in the spring of 2023. He fraudulently earned more than £284,000 of taxpayers' money. The prosecution accused the 56-year-old of ''deliberate, intentional dishonesty'' and of ''exploiting the system''. After seven hours of deliberation, the jury unanimously found Chowdhury guilty of eight counts of fraud by false representation and one count of fraud by a failure to disclose. The judge said Chowdhury faced a ''very significant custodial sentence''. He added he was refusing bail because of the significance of the crime and for Chowdhury's own wellbeing. 'Abused trust' "This was sustained and deliberate dishonesty," said Sarah Melo, specialist prosecutor at the CPS Serious Economic Organised Crime and International Directorate. "He knew he could not legitimately hold multiple full-time positions at the same time, but continued to conceal what he was doing." A Defra spokesperson said Chowdury "abused the trust placed in him as a public servant", adding that it would use all available avenues to recover the proceeds of Chowdhury's offending. Between 2020 and 2023 Chowdhury had eight full-time public sector roles that overlapped and earned him £350,000 in total. The prosecution told the court that on application forms he provided inaccurate information about his employment status and failed to disclose to government departments that he was already a civil servant. Once he secured the roles he didn't tell his employers he was working elsewhere. He was allowed to work entirely from home because he told his employers he was caring for his mother, whom he lived with in east London. She had dementia and was diagnosed with terminal cancer in 2023. - How a civil servant got away with juggling five jobs for so long - Published19 hours ago But rather than reduce his workload to look after her, he kept taking on new jobs. In the spring of 2023, when his mother was a few months away from death, he had jobs at the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, the Department of Health and Social Care, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), the Department for Business and Trade, the Food Standards Agency and the Home Office. During this period he was contracted to work 183 hours a week - more than the number of hours that exist in seven days. Chowdhury said he had taken on so many roles because he feared losing his livelihood after experiencing insecure employment in the past. He was made redundant from a job at the Department for Education in 2013 and was given a diagnosis of PTSD. He said he had not been thinking clearly when applying for jobs ''because of my stress, distress and trauma and due to my panic at the time". But the prosecution barrister, Lucy Organ, told the jury: "He's lied to you in evidence, he's lied to you under oath, which demonstrates the level of deceit he has descended to." A succession of his managers told the court about his poor performance. Especially damning was the evidence given by Dan McCartney who managed Chowdhury at Defra. He said he had to "effectively tell him what to do the whole time". McCartney said that during video calls Chowdhury had his camera switched off blaming technical problems. McCartney said this went on for four to five months. But McCartney said that because Chowdhury was not subject to any formal performance measures at Defra, he was given a permanent job and remained there for two years. The prosecution argued that he used sick notes to cope with his impossible schedule. In March 2023, he was on sick leave from four of the organisations he worked for. But he kept working at the Home Office and did not tell them he was ill. His line manager at the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), Aleesha Adams, organised a video call with him in May 2023. By this point he'd been off sick for three months and she wanted to make a plan to get him back to work. She told the jury that at the start of the call he was coughing a lot and waving tissues up to the camera. She also told the jury that he had been wearing white make-up to try to look ill. Adams told the court that as the meeting went on the make-up started coming off his forehead. ''He was sweating, it was like rubbing off so it was darker underneath and darker on the neck." Chowdhury told the jury this was a smear and that he had not been wearing make-up. After the call, Adams discovered that he had logged into the call using a Defra email address. When she challenged him about it he blamed a technical error. Adams grew suspicious. ''I believed he was lying,'' she told the jury. She escalated her concerns up the chain at the UKHSA. But his fraudulent behaviour went on for several more months. The government's National Fraud Initiative flagged suspected fraud to Defra in 2023. Following this, the Defra Investigations Team launched an investigation and as a result, Chowdhury was arrested and interviewed under caution in July 2023. He was dismissed by the civil service in September 2023. Chowdhury has also been accused by his siblings of bullying their mother into increasing his share of the family home days before she died. In a case at the High Court, Chowdhury's two brothers and sister allege that he put "undue influence" on Faijun Nessa to sign documents that meant he would inherit half of her home. The four-storey, six-bedroom home in east London has been valued at £2.1m. His siblings say their mother could not have understood what she was signing because she was "desperately unwell". In January 2023 she was given a terminal diagnosis of stage four metastatic colorectal cancer. The claimants also allege that Mrs Nessa, who was nearly blind and could not speak English, was unaware of what she was signing because the documents were not translated into her native Bengali at the time they were signed. Kashim Chowdhury denies the claims. That case is ongoing. Additional reporting by Ben Sturt.

items.summary: İran Genelkurmay Başkanı Tümgeneral Ali Abdullahi, ABD ve İsrail'le olası yeni bir çatışmada "birçok sürprizin ardı ardına ortaya çıkacağını" söyledi. Abdullahi, İran'ın hedef alınması halinde karşılık vereceklerini belirtti.

items.summaryTr: İran Genelkurmay Başkanı Tümgeneral Ali Abdullahi, ABD ve İsrail'le olası yeni bir çatışmada "birçok sürprizin ardı ardına ortaya çıkacağını" söyledi. Abdullahi, İran'ın hedef alınması halinde karşılık vereceklerini belirtti.
items.articleText: İran'dan savaş resti: "ABD ve İsrail'i bekleyen sürprizler var" - İran Genelkurmay Başkanı Tümgeneral Ali Abdullahi, ABD ve İsrail'le olası yeni bir çatışmada "birçok sürprizin ardı ardına ortaya çıkacağını" söyledi. - Abdullahi, İran'ın hedef alınması halinde karşılık vereceklerini belirtti. İran ile ABD ve İsrail arasındaki gerilim sürerken Tahran'dan yeni bir açıklama geldi. İran Genelkurmay Başkanı Tümgeneral Ali Abdullahi, olası bir savaşın yeniden başlaması halinde karşı tarafı bekleyen sürprizler olacağını ifade etti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İran resmi haber ajansı IRNA'nın aktardığına göre Abdullahi, Devrim Muhafızları Ordusunun yeni yer altı füze üssünün tanıtım töreninde konuştu. ABD ve İsrail'in tehditlerine değinen Abdullahi, düşmanın askeri gücünün ve sahip olduğu tesislerin İran'ın kararlarını etkilemeyeceğini söyledi. "Gelecekteki savaşta sürprizler olacak" İsrail Başbakanı Binyamin Netanyahu'nun İran'a yönelik açıklamalarına da yanıt veren Abdullahi, Netanyahu'nun "Ya İran'ı yok edeceğiz ya da İran bizi yok edecek" sözlerini hatırlattı. Abdullahi, İran'ın bu tehditlere boyun eğmeyeceğini belirterek, "Onları kesinlikle yok edeceğimiz açıktır" ifadelerini kullandı. İranlı komutan, önceki çatışmalarda ABD ve İsrail'in sahip oldukları askeri imkanları kullandıklarını ancak hedeflerine ulaşamadıklarını öne sürdü. Abdullahi, konuşmasını olası yeni çatışmaya ilişkin şu sözlerle tamamladı: "Gelecekteki savaşta sürprizler ardı ardına ortaya çıkacak."

items.title: Iran rejects French claims it was behind supermarket fridge hacking
items.summary: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.

items.titleTr: Iran rejects French claims it was behind supermarket fridge hacking
items.summaryTr: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.
items.articleText: Iran rejects French claims it was behind supermarket fridge hacking - Published Iran has described French accusations that it was behind cyber-attacks that raised the temperatures of supermarket fridges and freezers as "baseless and hostile". On Monday, the French authorities blamed Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) for the string of hacks, which foreign minister Jean-Noël Barrot said were "unprecedented" in terms of their scale and "level of aggression". He added that those responsible would be hit with sanctions. The French cyber-attacks, which led to the destruction of tons of frozen and chilled food, were followed by a similar hacks against supermarkets across several other European countries. It is not known if the instances are linked. Barrot said the attack on France's supermarkets "marks the first large-scale cyber-attack aimed at sabotage on our national territory, and it constitutes a major attack on the nation's interests and the security of the French people". He said the government had summoned the Iranian ambassador to Paris to "lodge a very strong protest against this extremely grave act". France will take "any other necessary and proportionate measures" to respond to the incident and "deter anyone who might seek to repeat it", Barrot added. The Paris prosecutor, Laure Beccuau, said an investigation had been opened into the head of an offensive cyber unit associated with the IRGC as well as his two deputies. Beccuau named the unit as Shahid Kaveh, which she said had an affiliation with the electronic and cyber centre of the IRGC. Shahid Kaveh is the name given to a cluster of hackers thought to be directly employed by the Iranian regime. In recent weeks, a number of commentators and politicians in Iran have argued that the country should extend any retaliation beyond the Middle East if the US and Israel resume the war they started earlier this year. On Monday, some Iranian media outlets denied the French accusations, but there had been no official comment until Tuesday's statement from Iran's foreign ministry. On 11 October, hackers gained control of the software that regulates the temperatures of the refrigeration units used in many of France's supermarkets. More than 100 of Coopérative U's supermarkets were hit, as well as 180 stores from Intermarché and its Netto brand. In some stores, temperatures of the fridges reportedly rose to 50C (120F) overnight. Other major food retailers including Carrefour, Monoprix and E.Leclerc were also hit by the attack, which targeted software provided by Danish engineering firm Danfoss. The software allows retailers to manage their cold units remotely. Earlier this month a second wave of hacks took place, hitting more than 100 stores across Europe. Supermarkets in Belgium and Luxembourg were affected, while a smaller number of shops were hit in countries including Sweden, Ireland, the Netherlands, Estonia and Finland. Separately in August a small number of US military bases had fridges mysteriously malfunction, spoiling food. This incident is also being investigated as deliberate cyber-attacks, Reuters news agency has reported, citing sources familiar with the matter. Since the waves of attacks on freezers, experts have been speculating which hacking groups could be responsible, with Iran being on a list of potential suspects. In spite of a pair of Russian-aligned hacktivist groups claiming they were responsible on Wednesday, few believed them. The French government has not said how it reached the conclusion that Iran was responsible, and attribution of cyber-attacks is extremely hard as hackers are able to hide their locations. Additional reporting by Farshad Bayan, BBC Persian. Related topics - Published2 November

items.title: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
items.summary: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.

items.titleTr: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
items.summaryTr: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.
items.articleText: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027. Wall Street’s embrace of Bitcoin has created the “best buying opportunity ever,” according to investor Mark Moss. Moss co-founded the Bitcoin Opportunity Fund, where he is an advisory partner. In 2025, UK-listed Satsuma Technology appointed him chief Bitcoin strategist. Moss tells Cointelegraph on the latest episode of Trade Secrets that he first bought Bitcoin in 2015 at about $300, during a recovery from a $1,000 to $200 plunge. “It was so risky,” Moss recalls of buying back then. In contrast, today, “you have consensus from the US government and Wall Street.” “But most people still think it’s a scam,” he says. That skepticism opens buying opportunities as Bitcoin starts to cross what Moss calls the “chasm” between early adopters and mainstream investors. Banks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have made Bitcoin easier to buy and financial advisers could help persuade clients who have stayed away previously to consider investing. Related: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks Moss calls bottom but Bitcoin keeps falling Bitcoin briefly climbed above $80,000 after the Democrats took control of the US Congress in the midterm elections, then gave back those gains as tech stocks sold off. By Friday, it fell to $74,762, its lowest level since August and remains in the doldrums at the time of writing. Despite the selloff, Moss points to the reaction to the $6.3 billion Binance hack as a sign that sellers were running out. “The price didn’t really drop,” he says. Bitcoin fell to $76,320 after the breach and slid to $74,762 on Friday, erasing its post-election gains. It fell further to about $73,500 late Sunday, its lowest level since August, after Nvidia’s board announced it would investigate reports that CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Bitcoin found another bottom after reports of Nvidia CEO’s scandal. Source: CoinMarketCap Flows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs swung sharply during election week. The funds took in about $75 million on Wednesday, then shed $430 million on Thursday. History is on the side of hodlers however. Bitcoin gained an average of about 53% in the 12 months after previous US midterms, Moss says, using data going back to 2014. That leaves three completed election cycles in his sample. He says he expects Bitcoin to set a new all-time high in 2027. Moss backs Strategy but would keep his Bitcoin Moss thinks the Bitcoin treasury company to own is Strategy (MSTR), but believes that holding Bitcoin yourself is still superior. Strategy began buying Bitcoin in 2020 and turned those purchases into a core part of its business. It has used stock and debt sales to fund its purchases, giving investors a way to bet on Bitcoin through a publicly traded company. By Nov. 2, Strategy held 849,327 BTC, more than 4% of Bitcoin’s maximum supply. “I don’t think there’s another publicly traded company that will outperform Strategy over the next ten years,” Moss says. Strategy has the world’s largest corporate Bitcoin trove. Source: BitcoinTreasuries.Net Leverage can help a Bitcoin treasury company’s shares outperform the cryptocurrency it holds when its price rises. But even if Strategy outperforms, Moss wouldn’t trade his Bitcoin holdings for its shares. Related: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold Before Moss bought his first Bitcoin, he made a living buying foreclosed properties, fixing them up and selling them. He moved into property development, then built and sold a medical equipment business. He says he put the proceeds into Southern California real estate. When the market crashed in 2008, he lost it all. “The reward of being right is not worth the risk of getting it wrong,” he says. Even with his outlook for Strategy, Moss says he’d keep his Bitcoin and use only a small share of his portfolio to pursue higher returns through treasury stocks. A journey of $1 million Bitcoin starts with small allocations In Moss’s model, Bitcoin could reach $1 million under certain circumstances, when it competes with stocks, bonds, gold and real estate for a considerable share of investors’ wealth. The model estimates how much those assets are worth, projects how that pool could grow as the global money supply expands and calculates a Bitcoin price based on the share it captures. Financial advisers could help bring in that money via one client’s portfolio at a time, encouraging them to shift a few percentage points out of stocks or bonds and into Bitcoin. The scenario depends on a critical mass of clients doing that, to the point where all those small allocations add up. The model also assumes Bitcoin stays secure and decentralized. Asked what could derail the scenario, Moss pointed to a failure that compromised either feature. Moss says $1 million is possible by 2030... though hodler’s might have to wait until 2032. Hodler’s Digest: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms

Wall Street’s embrace of Bitcoin has created the “best buying opportunity ever,” according to investor Mark Moss. Moss co-founded the Bitcoin Opportunity Fund, where he is an advisory partner. In 2025, UK-listed Satsuma Technology appointed him chief Bitcoin strategist. Moss tells Cointelegraph on the latest episode of Trade Secrets that he first bought Bitcoin in 2015 at about $300, during a recovery from a $1,000 to $200 plunge. “It was so risky,” Moss recalls of buying back then. In contrast, today, “you have consensus from the US government and Wall Street.” “But most people still think it’s a scam,” he says. That skepticism opens buying opportunities as Bitcoin starts to cross what Moss calls the “chasm” between early adopters and mainstream investors. Banks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have made Bitcoin easier to buy and financial advisers could help persuade clients who have stayed away previously to consider investing. Related: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks Moss calls bottom but Bitcoin keeps falling Bitcoin briefly climbed above $80,000 after the Democrats took control of the US Congress in the midterm elections, then gave back those gains as tech stocks sold off. By Friday, it fell to $74,762, its lowest level since August and remains in the doldrums at the time of writing. Despite the selloff, Moss points to the reaction to the $6.3 billion Binance hack as a sign that sellers were running out. “The price didn’t really drop,” he says. Bitcoin fell to $76,320 after the breach and slid to $74,762 on Friday, erasing its post-election gains. It fell further to about $73,500 late Sunday, its lowest level since August, after Nvidia’s board announced it would investigate reports that CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Bitcoin found another bottom after reports of Nvidia CEO’s scandal. Source: CoinMarketCap Flows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs swung sharply during election week. The funds took in about $75 million on Wednesday, then shed $430 million on Thursday. History is on the side of hodlers however. Bitcoin gained an average of about 53% in the 12 months after previous US midterms, Moss says, using data going back to 2014. That leaves three completed election cycles in his sample. He says he expects Bitcoin to set a new all-time high in 2027. Moss backs Strategy but would keep his Bitcoin Moss thinks the Bitcoin treasury company to own is Strategy (MSTR), but believes that holding Bitcoin yourself is still superior. Strategy began buying Bitcoin in 2020 and turned those purchases into a core part of its business. It has used stock and debt sales to fund its purchases, giving investors a way to bet on Bitcoin through a publicly traded company. By Nov. 2, Strategy held 849,327 BTC, more than 4% of Bitcoin’s maximum supply. “I don’t think there’s another publicly traded company that will outperform Strategy over the next ten years,” Moss says. Strategy has the world’s largest corporate Bitcoin trove. Source: BitcoinTreasuries.Net Leverage can help a Bitcoin treasury company’s shares outperform the cryptocurrency it holds when its price rises. But even if Strategy outperforms, Moss wouldn’t trade his Bitcoin holdings for its shares. Related: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold Before Moss bought his first Bitcoin, he made a living buying foreclosed properties, fixing them up and selling them. He moved into property development, then built and sold a medical equipment business. He says he put the proceeds into Southern California real estate. When the market crashed in 2008, he lost it all. “The reward of being right is not worth the risk of getting it wrong,” he says. Even with his outlook for Strategy, Moss says he’d keep his Bitcoin and use only a small share of his portfolio to pursue higher returns through treasury stocks. A journey of $1 million Bitcoin starts with small allocations In Moss’s model, Bitcoin could reach $1 million under certain circumstances, when it competes with stocks, bonds, gold and real estate for a considerable share of investors’ wealth. The model estimates how much those assets are worth, projects how that pool could grow as the global money supply expands and calculates a Bitcoin price based on the share it captures. Financial advisers could help bring in that money via one client’s portfolio at a time, encouraging them to shift a few percentage points out of stocks or bonds and into Bitcoin. The scenario depends on a critical mass of clients doing that, to the point where all those small allocations add up. The model also assumes Bitcoin stays secure and decentralized. Asked what could derail the scenario, Moss pointed to a failure that compromised either feature. Moss says $1 million is possible by 2030... though hodler’s might have to wait until 2032. Hodler’s Digest: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms

items.summaryTr: With 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and joined the fight against the occupying German forces.
items.articleText: French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104 - Published One of France's last Resistance heroes from World War Two has died at the age of 104. Solange Alexandre was also a rare woman who, with her future husband, created and commanded her own unit of anti-German fighters. After serving as a Resistance courier from 1941, three years later she founded the Pas-de-Boeuf network near the town of Ruillé-sur-Loir. With some 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and, after the Allied landings in Normandy on D-Day in 1944, joined the fight against the occupying German forces. President Emmanuel Macron was among many to pay tribute to Alexandre, after her death was announced at a nursing home in Le Mans. "She said she only ever did her duty. But her duty was our freedom. France will never forget. Thank you," Macron posted on social media. Born in 1922 in the Sarthe department of western France, Solange Alexandre, née Dubuisson, grew up in a patriotic family that had suffered in World War One. "My mother lost her first husband in the war, and my father was wounded in 1917. The words homeland and honour were very important to us. They were in my blood," she recalled in her memoirs. In June 1940 she heard on the radio the appeal from General Charles de Gaulle in London, calling on the French not to give up the struggle against Germany. She had never heard of him, but that did not matter. "From that moment I knew I had to join up," she wrote. Some months later she was recruited by a friend of her father's – a Tunisian-born French army veteran called Saïd Belhaffaf, who had joined the Resistance. Using the code-name Corlay, she criss-crossed the region around Le Mans by bicycle, gathering information and passing on messages. "There were no mobile phones back then, and no private cars either because of the lack of petrol. The bicycle was king," she said in an interview two years ago. In 1943 she met her first husband Guy Déliot, who had deserted from the French gendarmerie after refusing to arrest some Jews. The following April, with the Allied invasion approaching, they decided to take to the maquis, in other words live clandestinely in the forested hills, supplied with food by local farmers. Their group consisted of deserters from German forced labour programmes, as well as survivors from another Resistance outfit that had been destroyed by the enemy. There were also two airmen, one American and one Canadian. "Twice the Gestapo came for me, and twice I slipped through their hands," she later recalled. After taking part in the liberation of Tours in September 1944, she ended the war with the rank of sub-lieutenant in the French Interior Forces (FFI). Later she worked as a teacher and followed her husband on his many postings as an officer of the gendarmerie in French overseas territories. He was killed in 1960 in Martinique, and in 1981 she remarried. Twice Solange Alexandre turned down the Légion d'Honneur, saying that she had only done her duty and that others were more worthy. Finally in 2024 she relented. On receiving the award she said: "It is a great pleasure and a great honour. I am very proud – even if it is only a few weeks, or a few months, before I die." items.title: California police investigate after 27 fall ill at half-marathon running event
items.summary: A local hospital says runners had "unusual" symptoms after racing on an atypically hot day.

items.titleTr: California police investigate after 27 fall ill at half-marathon running event
items.summaryTr: A local hospital says runners had "unusual" symptoms after racing on an atypically hot day.
items.articleText: California police investigate after 27 fall ill at half-marathon running event - Published Police in Santa Barbara, California, are investigating after nearly 30 people had to seek medical care at a half-marathon running event held in the city on Sunday. In a statement provided to the BBC's US partner CBS News, officers said they received a report from Santa Barbara Cottage Hospital about race participants who sought medical treatment "for unusual symptoms" after the race ended. "The cause of the reported symptoms has not been confirmed," the statement added. Cottage Health, which operates the hospital, told CBS it had seen "a larger than expected number of emergency visits" from those who ran the race. "There is no specific action recommended for the public at this time; however, participants who feel unwell should seek medical attention and follow guidance from healthcare professionals," police said. Cottage Hospital said it treated 27 people from the half marathon at emergency rooms in Santa Barbara and the nearby city of Goleta. The vast majority of them - 24 - were discharged after treatment, while three people were still in hospital as of Monday in stable condition. Several thousand people ran the half marathon on a hotter-than-usual day in Santa Barbara along the Pacific Ocean. Temperatures reportedly reached 86F (27C) by midday, compared to a typical early November temperature of low 70s. One of the runners who went to hospital told local news outlet KEYT-TV that they had lost consciousness and could not remember parts of the race. "It is awfully suspicious," said the runner, who declined to be identified. "We had people saying they were hallucinating." "I am not too familiar with heat exhaustion but I have never seen anyone not remembering a long portion of their run," the runner added. Event director David Monico told US media that 15 people were taken from the medical tent to local hospitals because of dehydration and overheating. The BBC has contacted the Santa Barbara Police Department, Cottage Health and the half marathon organisers for further comment. Related topics - Published6 days ago - Published6 days ago

items.articleText: Türk iş insanından siber saldırı uyarısı: İngiltere'de 158 yıllık şirket iflas etti - Avrupalı Türk Markalar Birliği Başkanı Vehbi Keleş, kendi şirketinin de siber saldırıya uğradığını açıklayarak işletmeleri uyardı. İngiltere'de 158 yıllık, 700 çalışanlı bir şirketin siber saldırı sonrası iflas ettiğini belirten Keleş, alınması gereken önlemleri anlattı. Avrupalı Türk Markalar Birliği (ATMB) Başkanı Vehbi Keleş, CNBC-e Londra Temsilcisi Berfu Güven'in canlı yayında yönelttiği soruları yanıtladı. İngiltere'deki Türk markalarının 2026 yılındaki performansını değerlendiren Keleş, artan enerji ve nakliye maliyetleri, tüketicilerin stok yapma eğilimi, siber saldırılar ve Türkiye ile İngiltere arasındaki ticari ilişkiler hakkında açıklamalarda bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Enerji maliyetlerindeki artışın önce nakliyeye, ardından üretime ve diğer alanlara yansıdığını belirten Keleş, Türk markalarını en fazla zorlayan unsurun nakliye maliyetleri olduğunu söyledi. Nakliye giderlerinin petrol fiyatlarına bağlı olduğunu ifade eden Keleş, Kızıldeniz'de yaşanan sorunlar nedeniyle sevkiyat sürelerinin de uzayabildiğini kaydetti. Türkiye dahil 36 ülkeden ürün getirerek İngiltere pazarında satışa sunduklarını belirten Keleş, tüketicilerin evde stok yapmaya yönelik çağrılarının satışlara etkisini de değerlendirdi. Makarna, bakliyat ve konserve satışlarında yüzde 40'a varan artış İngiltere'de stok yapma çağrılarının ardından bazı ürün gruplarında satışların arttığını belirten Keleş, ancak pandemi dönemindekine benzer bir kaos yaşanmadığını söyledi. Makarna, bakliyat ve konserve gibi ürünlerin satışlarında yüzde 20 ile yüzde 40 arasında artış görüldüğünü ifade eden Keleş, bunun tüketimin aynı oranda arttığı anlamına gelmediğini vurguladı. Satın alınan ürünlerin evlerde bekletildiğini belirten Keleş, öne çekilen alışverişlerin ilerleyen dönemlerde satışların yavaşlamasına neden olabileceğini söyledi. Pandemi döneminin şirketler açısından önemli bir tecrübe olduğunu ifade eden Keleş, Türk markalarının mevcut sürece hazırlıklı olduğunu dile getirdi. "Siber saldırıyı ben yaşadım" Avrupa'da yaşanan siber saldırıların şu aşamada Türk markaları açısından bir sorun oluşturmadığını belirten Keleş, kendi şirketinin de geçen yıl siber saldırıya uğradığını açıkladı. Saldırının ardından şirketin sistemlerine erişilemediğini anlatan Keleş, müşteri listeleri ve adresler dahil birçok veriye ulaşılamadığını söyledi. Yedekleme sisteminin de saldırıdan etkilendiğini belirten Keleş, çalışanlarına her akşam USB belleklere manuel yedek almalarını söylediğini ifade etti. Bu yedekler sayesinde ertesi gün sistemleri yeniden kurabildiklerini aktaran Keleş, şirketin veri kaybı yaşamadan faaliyetlerine devam ettiğini belirtti. Saldırı sonrasında yeni sunucular ve güvenlik duvarları için 30-40 bin civarında bir maliyet oluştuğunu söyleyen Keleş, asıl büyük riskin şirketin tamamen kaybedilmesi olduğunu vurguladı. İngiltere'de yaklaşık 158 yıllık geçmişe ve 700 çalışana sahip bir nakliye şirketinin siber saldırı sonrasında iflas ettiğini belirten Keleş, manuel yedekleme sistemleri bulunmasaydı kendi şirketlerinin de çok büyük maliyetlerle karşılaşabileceğini söyledi. "Bana olmaz demeyin" uyarısı İnternete bağlı her sistemin siber saldırılara açık olduğunu belirten Keleş, şirketleri güvenlik önlemleri konusunda uyardı. Özellikle soğuk hava depolarında kullanılan cihazların fabrika çıkış şifrelerinin değiştirilmesi gerektiğini söyleyen Keleş, bu cihazlar için yeni ve güvenli şifreler oluşturulmasının önemine dikkat çekti. Fransa'da yaşanan bir siber saldırının ardından İngiltere'deki üç soğuk hava deposunun da saldırıya uğradığını belirten Keleş, kendi şirketlerine yönelik saldırının Ukrayna üzerinden geldiğini ancak bunun saldırıyı gerçekleştiren kişinin Ukraynalı olduğu anlamına gelmediğini ifade etti. Stok çağrıları raf fiyatlarına yansımadı Stok yapma çağrılarının ve şirketlerin aldığı ek tedbirlerin şu aşamada raf fiyatlarına yansımadığını belirten Keleş, tüketicilerin paniğe kapılmasına gerek olmadığını söyledi. Keleş, sürecin normal seyrinde devam etmesi halinde ilave maliyetlerin de raf fiyatlarına yansımayabileceğini ifade etti. Türkiye ile İngiltere arasındaki yeni anlaşma için 2027 beklentisi Türkiye ile İngiltere arasında müzakere edilen yeni serbest ticaret anlaşmasına ilişkin de değerlendirmelerde bulunan Keleş, imza takviminin henüz netleşmediğini söyledi. Anlaşmanın büyük ihtimalle 2027 yılının ilk altı ayında imzalanmasını beklediklerini belirten Keleş, iki ülke arasındaki dış ticaret verilerini de paylaştı. Ekim sonu itibarıyla Türkiye'nin İngiltere'ye ihracatında yüzde 2,2 düşüş görüldüğünü ifade eden Keleş, Birleşik Krallık'ın Türkiye'ye ihracatında ise yüzde 2,9 artış yaşandığını belirtti. Sektörel verilere de değinen Keleş, Türkiye'nin İngiltere'ye ihracatında gıdada yüzde 3, hazır giyimde yüzde 7 ve mobilyada yüzde 2 düşüş görüldüğünü söyledi. Otomotiv sektöründe de gerileme yaşandığını ifade etti. Buna karşılık elektrik ve elektronik sektöründe yüzde 11, çelik sektöründe ise yaklaşık yüzde 60 artış kaydedildiğini belirtti. Türk markaları İngiliz marketlerinde neden etnik ürün raflarında kalıyor? Yaklaşık 20 yıldır İngiltere'deki zincir marketlere ürün verdiklerini belirten Keleş, Türk markalarının bu pazarda karşılaştığı sorunlara da değindi. Türkiye'nin küresel ölçekte tanınan bir markasının bulunmamasının zincir marketlerdeki konumlarını etkilediğini söyleyen Keleş, Türk ürünlerinin çoğunlukla etnik ürün raflarında yer aldığını ifade etti. Türkiye'de çok büyük olan bir markanın İngiliz market zincirleri açısından daha önce hiç karşılaşılmamış bir ürün olabileceğini belirten Keleş, markaların uluslararası pazarlarda tanınması için küreselleşmeye ve marka yatırımlarına önem verilmesi gerektiğini söyledi. 2027'de fiyatlar düşebilir İngiltere'deki Türk markalarının 2027 yılına ilişkin beklentilerini de paylaşan Keleş, mevcut sorunların çözülmesi halinde fiyatların yeniden düşmeye başlayabileceğini ifade etti. Keleş, 2027 yılının herkesin güzel ticaret yaptığı önemli bir yıl olmasını umut ettiklerini söyledi.

Makarna, bakliyat ve konserve gibi ürünlerin satışlarında yüzde 20 ile yüzde 40 arasında artış görüldüğünü ifade eden Keleş, bunun tüketimin aynı oranda arttığı anlamına gelmediğini vurguladı. Satın alınan ürünlerin evlerde bekletildiğini belirten Keleş, öne çekilen alışverişlerin ilerleyen dönemlerde satışların yavaşlamasına neden olabileceğini söyledi. Pandemi döneminin şirketler açısından önemli bir tecrübe olduğunu ifade eden Keleş, Türk markalarının mevcut sürece hazırlıklı olduğunu dile getirdi. "Siber saldırıyı ben yaşadım" Avrupa'da yaşanan siber saldırıların şu aşamada Türk markaları açısından bir sorun oluşturmadığını belirten Keleş, kendi şirketinin de geçen yıl siber saldırıya uğradığını açıkladı. Saldırının ardından şirketin sistemlerine erişilemediğini anlatan Keleş, müşteri listeleri ve adresler dahil birçok veriye ulaşılamadığını söyledi. Yedekleme sisteminin de saldırıdan etkilendiğini belirten Keleş, çalışanlarına her akşam USB belleklere manuel yedek almalarını söylediğini ifade etti. Bu yedekler sayesinde ertesi gün sistemleri yeniden kurabildiklerini aktaran Keleş, şirketin veri kaybı yaşamadan faaliyetlerine devam ettiğini belirtti. Saldırı sonrasında yeni sunucular ve güvenlik duvarları için 30-40 bin civarında bir maliyet oluştuğunu söyleyen Keleş, asıl büyük riskin şirketin tamamen kaybedilmesi olduğunu vurguladı. İngiltere'de yaklaşık 158 yıllık geçmişe ve 700 çalışana sahip bir nakliye şirketinin siber saldırı sonrasında iflas ettiğini belirten Keleş, manuel yedekleme sistemleri bulunmasaydı kendi şirketlerinin de çok büyük maliyetlerle karşılaşabileceğini söyledi. "Bana olmaz demeyin" uyarısı İnternete bağlı her sistemin siber saldırılara açık olduğunu belirten Keleş, şirketleri güvenlik önlemleri konusunda uyardı. Özellikle soğuk hava depolarında kullanılan cihazların fabrika çıkış şifrelerinin değiştirilmesi gerektiğini söyleyen Keleş, bu cihazlar için yeni ve güvenli şifreler oluşturulmasının önemine dikkat çekti. Fransa'da yaşanan bir siber saldırının ardından İngiltere'deki üç soğuk hava deposunun da saldırıya uğradığını belirten Keleş, kendi şirketlerine yönelik saldırının Ukrayna üzerinden geldiğini ancak bunun saldırıyı gerçekleştiren kişinin Ukraynalı olduğu anlamına gelmediğini ifade etti. Stok çağrıları raf fiyatlarına yansımadı Stok yapma çağrılarının ve şirketlerin aldığı ek tedbirlerin şu aşamada raf fiyatlarına yansımadığını belirten Keleş, tüketicilerin paniğe kapılmasına gerek olmadığını söyledi. Keleş, sürecin normal seyrinde devam etmesi halinde ilave maliyetlerin de raf fiyatlarına yansımayabileceğini ifade etti. Türkiye ile İngiltere arasındaki yeni anlaşma için 2027 beklentisi Türkiye ile İngiltere arasında müzakere edilen yeni serbest ticaret anlaşmasına ilişkin de değerlendirmelerde bulunan Keleş, imza takviminin henüz netleşmediğini söyledi. Anlaşmanın büyük ihtimalle 2027 yılının ilk altı ayında imzalanmasını beklediklerini belirten Keleş, iki ülke arasındaki dış ticaret verilerini de paylaştı. Ekim sonu itibarıyla Türkiye'nin İngiltere'ye ihracatında yüzde 2,2 düşüş görüldüğünü ifade eden Keleş, Birleşik Krallık'ın Türkiye'ye ihracatında ise yüzde 2,9 artış yaşandığını belirtti. Sektörel verilere de değinen Keleş, Türkiye'nin İngiltere'ye ihracatında gıdada yüzde 3, hazır giyimde yüzde 7 ve mobilyada yüzde 2 düşüş görüldüğünü söyledi. Otomotiv sektöründe de gerileme yaşandığını ifade etti. Buna karşılık elektrik ve elektronik sektöründe yüzde 11, çelik sektöründe ise yaklaşık yüzde 60 artış kaydedildiğini belirtti. Türk markaları İngiliz marketlerinde neden etnik ürün raflarında kalıyor? Yaklaşık 20 yıldır İngiltere'deki zincir marketlere ürün verdiklerini belirten Keleş, Türk markalarının bu pazarda karşılaştığı sorunlara da değindi. Türkiye'nin küresel ölçekte tanınan bir markasının bulunmamasının zincir marketlerdeki konumlarını etkilediğini söyleyen Keleş, Türk ürünlerinin çoğunlukla etnik ürün raflarında yer aldığını ifade etti. Türkiye'de çok büyük olan bir markanın İngiliz market zincirleri açısından daha önce hiç karşılaşılmamış bir ürün olabileceğini belirten Keleş, markaların uluslararası pazarlarda tanınması için küreselleşmeye ve marka yatırımlarına önem verilmesi gerektiğini söyledi. 2027'de fiyatlar düşebilir İngiltere'deki Türk markalarının 2027 yılına ilişkin beklentilerini de paylaşan Keleş, mevcut sorunların çözülmesi halinde fiyatların yeniden düşmeye başlayabileceğini ifade etti. Keleş, 2027 yılının herkesin güzel ticaret yaptığı önemli bir yıl olmasını umut ettiklerini söyledi.

items.titleTr: Anthropic to raise $64bn in major stock market listing
items.summaryTr: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78.
items.articleText: Anthropic to raise $64bn in major stock market listing - Published Anthropic, the AI company behind the Claude chatbot, is planning to raise up to $64bn (£48bn) when it lists its shares for sale on New York's Nasdaq stock exchange. The loss-making company said it will offer its shares for between $70 and $78 each in its initial public offering (IPO), which is expected to go ahead this month. This would value Anthropic at between $1.1 trillion and $1.3 trillion which, although large, is below the $2 trillion some analysts had predicted weeks ago. It is floating at a volatile time for AI firms. After last week's US midterm elections, the Nasdaq fell sharply on concerns a Democrat-led Congress could slow development of AI and the buildout of data centres. There are also wider fears over the billions of dollars being spent on AI and whether it will pay off. In its most recent results for the six months to the end of June, Anthropic's revenues jumped to $16.2bn from $1.1bn in the same period last year. However, its pre-tax loss jumped to $80.7bn from $12.9bn. Fiona Cincotta, a senior market analyst at City Index, said $64bn Anthropic wants to raise is "fairly bullish" within "the volatility [and] concerns towards AI that we've seen in sort of particularly last week". She told Reuters: "It's showing that they are still sort of upbeat about the outlook as far as AI is concerned and that obviously that they think that the demand is going to be there." items.summaryTr: ABD'de Tüketici Fiyat Endeksi (TÜFE), ekimde aylık yüzde 0,4 arttı. Böylece aylık enflasyon eylüldeki yüzde 0,6 seviyesinden gerilerken, gıda ve enerji hariç çekirdek TÜFE yüzde 0,3 yükseldi.
items.articleText: Piyasaların odağındaki veri açıklandı: ABD'de enflasyon beklentileri aştı ABD'de Tüketici Fiyat Endeksi (TÜFE), ekimde aylık yüzde 0,4 arttı. Böylece aylık enflasyon eylüldeki yüzde 0,6 seviyesinden gerilerken, gıda ve enerji hariç çekirdek TÜFE yüzde 0,3 yükseldi. ABD Çalışma İstatistikleri Bürosu, ağustos ayına ilişkin tüketici fiyat endeksi verilerini açıkladı. ABD'de tüketicilerin kısa, orta ve uzun vadeli enflasyon beklentileri Ekim ayında değişmeyerek sırasıyla yüzde 3,9, yüzde 3,3 ve yüzde 3 seviyelerinde kalmıştı. Açıklanan verilere göre ABD'de Tüketici Fiyat Endeksi (TÜFE), ekim ayında aylık bazda yüzde 0,4 artarak eylüldeki yüzde 0,6'lık yükselişin altında gerçekleşti. ABD Çalışma İstatistikleri Bürosu (BLS), Ekim 2026 dönemine ilişkin tüketici fiyat endeksi verilerini açıkladı. Buna göre, Tüketici Fiyat Endeksi ekimde mevsim etkilerinden arındırılmış olarak aylık bazda yüzde 0,4 arttı. Endeks, eylül ayında yüzde 0,6 yükselmişti. Barınma endeksi ekimde yüzde 0,3 artarken, bu kalem aylık enflasyondaki toplam yükselişin yüzde 30'undan fazlasını oluşturdu. Gıda endeksi aynı dönemde yüzde 0,5 artış kaydetti. Evde tüketilen gıda fiyatları yüzde 0,4, dışarıda tüketilen gıda fiyatları ise yüzde 0,5 yükseldi. Enerji endeksi de ekimde yüzde 0,7 arttı. Söz konusu endekste eylül ayında yüzde 5,2'lik artış yaşanmıştı. Çekirdek enflasyon yüzde 0,3 arttı Gıda ve enerji kalemlerinin hariç tutulduğu çekirdek TÜFE, ekimde aylık bazda yüzde 0,3 yükseldi. Çekirdek enflasyondaki artış ağustos ve eylül aylarında da yüzde 0,3 olarak kaydedilmişti. Ekim ayında eğlence, sağlık hizmetleri, motorlu taşıt sigortası, ev eşyaları ve hizmetleri ile eğitim kalemlerinde fiyat artışları görüldü. Buna karşılık, kullanılmış otomobil ve kamyon fiyatları ile iletişim endeksinde düşüş kaydedildi.

items.title: Bitcoin may benefit as global tightening slows, Binance Research says
items.summary: Binance Research says Bitcoin could find support as global monetary tightening slows, even as markets price in a December Fed rate hike.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Bitcoin may benefit as global tightening slows, Binance Research says
items.summaryTr: Binance Research says Bitcoin could find support as global monetary tightening slows, even as markets price in a December Fed rate hike.
items.articleText: Bitcoin may benefit as global tightening slows, Binance Research says Binance Research says Bitcoin could find support as global monetary tightening slows, even as markets price in a December Fed rate hike. Bitcoin could find support before major central banks start cutting rates if the spread of rate hikes continues to slow, Binance Research said Tuesday. Eight of the 10 central banks Binance tracks had raised rates over the last six months, including Sweden’s announced increase on Nov. 4, with the momentum of tightening starting to ease since its July peak, Binance Research said in a Tuesday report shared with Cointelegraph. “Whether this easing continues into early 2027 will be key to judging whether the macro backdrop is turning less hostile for crypto,” the report said. Binance pointed to the previous cycle. Bitcoin (BTC) bottomed in November 2022, and its six-month return turned positive in February 2023, before any of the central banks in the index began cutting rates. Pace of G10 banks tightening and Bitcoin’s 6-month returns. Source: Binance Research Similarly, in 2024, monetary tightening measures led to Bitcoin delivering its “strongest” six-month return of the cycle, exceeding 160% in March, Binance said. “In each case, BTC moved with the direction of global policy, not its level,” the report adds. Related: Analysts see no broader ‘contagion’ from $6.3B Binance hack December rate hike odds mount following Waller’s speech A US rate increase remains in play. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said Tuesday he was leaning toward a quarter-point hike in December and would consider a half-point move if core inflation remained elevated. Odds of a 25-basis-point hike in December rose from 76.3% to 96.3% on Tuesday, according to CME Group’s FedWatch Tool. In a Nov. 2 report, Bitwise also argued that a slowdown in economic growth expectations could eventually prompt central banks to pivot towards easing monetary policy, potentially creating a more favourable environment for Bitcoin. BTC/USD, 1-year chart. Source: CoinMarketCap Bitcoin’s price fell 3.5% during the past week, extending its one-year decline to 30%. The world’s first cryptocurrency was trading at $74,131, or 41% below its $126,198 all-time high, according to CoinMarketCap. Magazine: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen

items.articleText: Goldman Sachs CEO'su açıkladı: Yapay zekaya milyarlarca dolarlık talep sürüyor - Goldman Sachs CEO'su David Solomon, yapay zeka altyapısına yönelik yatırımların geri dönüşüne ilişkin soru işaretlerine rağmen finansman talebinin güçlü seyrettiğini söyledi. Goldman Sachs Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) David Solomon, yapay zeka sektöründeki yatırım iştahının sürdüğünü belirtti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC'ye konuşan Solomon, yatırımcıların altyapı harcamalarının geri dönüşünü yeniden değerlendirdiği bir dönemde, yapay zeka sermaye piyasası işlemlerinde son haftalarda oldukça aktif olduklarını söyledi. Solomon, yapay zeka altyapısının kurulmasına ve teknolojinin büyümesini destekleyen yatırımlara yönelik talebin güçlü kalmaya devam ettiğini ifade etti. Yapay zeka hisselerinde satış baskısı Solomon, siyasi ortamda yaşanan değişimlerin piyasada yeniden ayarlamalara ve dalgalanmalara yol açabileceğini belirtti. Buna karşın yapay zekanın ekonomide verimliliği artırma potansiyeline ilişkin uzun vadeli iyimserliğini koruduğunu dile getirdi. Çip üreticileri ve yeni nesil bulut hizmeti sağlayıcıları dahil olmak üzere yapay zeka bağlantılı hisseler, son haftalarda sert satışlarla karşılaştı. Yatırımcılar, sektöre aktarılan yüz milyarlarca dolarlık sermayenin yeterli getiri sağlayıp sağlamayacağını sorgulamaya başladı. ABD ara seçimleri öncesinde başlayan satış baskısı, Demokratların seçimlerde elde ettiği sonuçların ardından sektör üzerindeki siyasi baskının artabileceği endişesiyle derinleşti. Anthropic'in halka arz süreci yakından izleniyor Piyasa algısındaki değişim, halka arza hazırlanan yapay zeka şirketi Anthropic açısından da önemli bir döneme denk geldi. Goldman Sachs, şirketin halka arz sürecine liderlik eden bankalar arasında bulunuyor. Yapay zeka yatırımlarında veri merkezleri, çipler, enerji altyapısı ve bulut hizmetleri için yapılan harcamalar öne çıkıyor. Yatırımcıların odağında ise bu yüksek maliyetli yatırımların ne zaman ve hangi ölçüde gelir ve kâra dönüşeceği bulunuyor.
items.articleTextTr: Goldman Sachs CEO'su açıkladı: Yapay zekaya milyarlarca dolarlık talep sürüyor - Goldman Sachs CEO'su David Solomon, yapay zeka altyapısına yönelik yatırımların geri dönüşüne ilişkin soru işaretlerine rağmen finansman talebinin güçlü seyrettiğini söyledi. Goldman Sachs Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) David Solomon, yapay zeka sektöründeki yatırım iştahının sürdüğünü belirtti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC'ye konuşan Solomon, yatırımcıların altyapı harcamalarının geri dönüşünü yeniden değerlendirdiği bir dönemde, yapay zeka sermaye piyasası işlemlerinde son haftalarda oldukça aktif olduklarını söyledi. Solomon, yapay zeka altyapısının kurulmasına ve teknolojinin büyümesini destekleyen yatırımlara yönelik talebin güçlü kalmaya devam ettiğini ifade etti. Yapay zeka hisselerinde satış baskısı Solomon, siyasi ortamda yaşanan değişimlerin piyasada yeniden ayarlamalara ve dalgalanmalara yol açabileceğini belirtti. Buna karşın yapay zekanın ekonomide verimliliği artırma potansiyeline ilişkin uzun vadeli iyimserliğini koruduğunu dile getirdi. Çip üreticileri ve yeni nesil bulut hizmeti sağlayıcıları dahil olmak üzere yapay zeka bağlantılı hisseler, son haftalarda sert satışlarla karşılaştı. Yatırımcılar, sektöre aktarılan yüz milyarlarca dolarlık sermayenin yeterli getiri sağlayıp sağlamayacağını sorgulamaya başladı. ABD ara seçimleri öncesinde başlayan satış baskısı, Demokratların seçimlerde elde ettiği sonuçların ardından sektör üzerindeki siyasi baskının artabileceği endişesiyle derinleşti. Anthropic'in halka arz süreci yakından izleniyor Piyasa algısındaki değişim, halka arza hazırlanan yapay zeka şirketi Anthropic açısından da önemli bir döneme denk geldi. Goldman Sachs, şirketin halka arz sürecine liderlik eden bankalar arasında bulunuyor. items.summary: Rusya'da mahkeme, yasaklı içerikleri kaldırmadıkları gerekçesiyle Apple, Google, Telegram ve Wikimedia Vakfına toplam 26,3 milyon ruble (yaklaşık 318 bin dolar) para cezası verdi.

items.summaryTr: Rusya'da mahkeme, yasaklı içerikleri kaldırmadıkları gerekçesiyle Apple, Google, Telegram ve Wikimedia Vakfına toplam 26,3 milyon ruble (yaklaşık 318 bin dolar) para cezası verdi.
items.articleText: Rusya'dan teknoloji devlerine ceza: Apple, Google ve Telegram'a milyonluk yaptırım - Rusya'da mahkeme, yasaklı içerikleri kaldırmadıkları gerekçesiyle Apple, Google, Telegram ve Wikimedia Vakfına toplam 26,3 milyon ruble (yaklaşık 318 bin dolar) para cezası verdi. Rusya'da teknoloji şirketlerine yönelik yaptırımlara bir yenisi eklendi. Moskova'daki Taganskiy Bölge Mahkemesi, ülkede yasaklı kabul edilen içerikleri kaldırmadıkları gerekçesiyle Apple, Google, Telegram ve Wikipedia'nın işletmecisi Wikimedia Vakfına para cezası uygulanmasına karar verdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Mahkemenin kararına göre Wikimedia Vakfı 15,2 milyon ruble, Google ve Telegram ayrı ayrı 3,8 milyon ruble, Apple ise 3,5 milyon ruble ceza ödeyecek. Telegram'a yönelik suçlama dikkat çekti Şirketlere verilen cezaların gerekçesi, Rusya'da yasaklı içeriklerin kaldırılmaması ve ilgili yasal yükümlülüklerin yerine getirilmemesi olarak açıklandı. Telegram'a yönelik davanın, Rusya Silahlı Kuvvetleri hakkında yanlış bilgi içerdiği belirtilen paylaşımlarla ilgili olduğu bildirildi. Apple hakkındaki duruşmanın ise şirketin gizli bilgilerinin paylaşılabileceği gerekçesiyle basına kapalı gerçekleştirildiği aktarıldı. Rusya, daha önce de yasaklı içerikleri kaldırmadıkları veya ülkedeki yasal düzenlemelere uymadıkları gerekçesiyle teknoloji şirketlerine para cezaları uygulamıştı. Bu yaptırımlar, ülkede faaliyet gösteren küresel dijital platformlarla Rus makamları arasındaki hukuki anlaşmazlıkların bir parçası olarak öne çıkıyor.

items.articleText: Bitcoin'de satış dalgası büyüyor: Şirketler ve fonlarda milyarlık çıkış - Bitcoin piyasasında satış baskısı sürerken şirketlerin elindeki BTC miktarı geçen hafta 11 bin 647 azaldı. ABD'deki spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinden ise 2-9 Kasım döneminde yaklaşık 1,48 milyar dolarlık net sermaye çıkışı gerçekleşti. Bitcoin piyasasında satış baskısı devam ederken, şirketlerin elinde bulundurduğu BTC miktarında ve ABD'deki spot Bitcoin borsa yatırım fonlarında (ETF) dikkat çekici düşüşler yaşandı. Şirketlerin Bitcoin varlıkları geçen hafta 11 bin 647 BTC azalırken, spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinden 2-9 Kasım döneminde yaklaşık 1,48 milyar dolarlık net sermaye çıkışı gerçekleşti. Şirketlerin Bitcoin varlıklarında 869 milyon dolarlık azalış CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketlerin elinde bulundurduğu toplam Bitcoin miktarı geçen hafta net 11 bin 647 BTC azaldı. Söz konusu düşüşün parasal karşılığı yaklaşık 869 milyon dolar olarak hesaplandı. Veriler, şirketlerin Bitcoin varlıklarında hafta boyunca gerçekleşen artış ve azalışların birbirinden mahsup edilmesiyle ortaya çıkan net değişimi gösteriyor. Bu nedenle 11 bin 647 BTC'lik düşüş, şirketlerin hafta boyunca gerçekleştirdiği toplam satış veya transfer miktarını doğrudan yansıtmıyor. Benzer şekilde 869 milyon dolarlık tutar da ayrı bir zarar kalemi değil, Bitcoin miktarındaki net azalmanın dolar karşılığı olarak değerlendiriliyor. Bitcoin ETF'lerinden 1,48 milyar dolar çıktı Kurumsal yatırımcıların Bitcoin'e erişim sağladığı spot ETF'lerde de sermaye çıkışları dikkat çekti. ABD'de işlem gören spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinden 9 Kasım'da toplam 201 milyon dolarlık net sermaye çıkışı gerçekleşti. Fon bazında bakıldığında, BlackRock'ın iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) fonu 213,2 milyon dolarlık net çıkışla en fazla sermaye kaybeden fon oldu. Buna karşılık MSBT fonuna 22,1 milyon dolarlık net sermaye girişi gerçekleşerek toplam çıkışı kısmen dengeledi. 2-9 Kasım döneminin tamamında ise ABD spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinden toplam 1 milyar 482,7 milyon dolarlık net sermaye çıkışı kaydedildi. Bu süreçte 4 Kasım'da görülen 74,6 milyon dolarlık net giriş, genel çıkış eğiliminden ayrışan tek günlük hareket olarak öne çıktı.

items.summaryTr: Petrol Ofisi Grubu, EPDK'nin ağustos ayı verilerine göre toptan akaryakıt satışlarındaki pazar payını yüzde 30'a yükseltti. Şirket yöneticileri, 2027'de jeopolitik risklerin ve yüksek borçlanma maliyetlerinin etkisini sürdüreceği öngörüsünü paylaştı.
items.articleText: Petrol Ofisi'nin toptan akaryakıt pazarındaki payı yüzde 30'a çıktı - Petrol Ofisi Grubu, EPDK'nin ağustos ayı verilerine göre toptan akaryakıt satışlarındaki pazar payını yüzde 30'a yükseltti. Şirket yöneticileri, 2027'de jeopolitik risklerin ve yüksek borçlanma maliyetlerinin etkisini sürdüreceği öngörüsünü paylaştı. Petrol Ofisi Grubu, EPDK'nin 2026 yılı ağustos ayı verilerine göre toptan akaryakıt satışlarındaki pazar payını yüzde 30'a yükselterek sektördeki liderliğini sürdürdü. Şirket, 2027 yılında enerji piyasasını bekleyen gelişmelere ilişkin öngörülerini de iş ortaklarıyla paylaştı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketten yapılan açıklamaya göre, Petrol Ofisi Grubu, toptan akaryakıt satışlarındaki pazar liderliğini İstanbul'da düzenlediği Toptan Satışlar Bayi Toplantısı'nda iş ortaklarıyla kutladı. 2027 yılına ilişkin beklentiler değerlendirildi Four Seasons Hotel Bosphorus'ta "Birlikte güçlüyüz" temasıyla gerçekleştirilen toplantıya Petrol Ofisi Grubu Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) Mehmet Abbasoğlu, Ticari ve Endüstriyel Satışlar Direktörü Ulvi Kılıç ve Akaryakıt Toptan Satışlar Kıdemli Müdürü Celal Ersan katıldı. Sektörün son üç yıldaki gelişiminin ele alındığı toplantıda, küresel krizlerin akaryakıt piyasasına etkileri, kesintisiz yakıt tedariki ve 2027 yılına ilişkin beklentiler değerlendirildi. Açıklamada, EPDK verilerine göre 2025'te yüzde 25,7 pazar payına ulaşarak sektördeki liderliğini üst üste 18 yıl sürdüren şirketin, bu yılın ağustos ayı itibarıyla pazar payını yüzde 30'a yükselttiği belirtildi. Türkiye genelinde 400'ü aşkın toptan satış bayisi aracılığıyla ticari ve endüstriyel müşterilerine hizmet veren Petrol Ofisi Grubu, 9 akaryakıt terminali ve 1,5 milyon metreküplük yakıt depolama kapasitesiyle tedarik faaliyetlerini sürdürüyor. Açıklamada görüşlerine yer verilen Petrol Ofisi Grubu Akaryakıt Toptan Satışlar Kıdemli Müdürü Ersan, küresel krizler, savaşlar ve ambargolar nedeniyle sürdürülebilir akaryakıt tedarikinin giderek zorlaştığını belirterek, bu süreçte iş ortaklarına kesintisiz ürün sağlamayı sürdürdüklerini ifade etti. Ersan, 2027'ye ilişkin değerlendirmesinde küresel ekonomik belirsizliklerin ve jeopolitik krizlerin etkisini sürdüreceğini belirtti. İş ortaklarıyla çalışmanın önemine dikkat çekildi Enerji arz güvenliğinin hem Türkiye’nin hem de dünyanın öncelikli gündem maddelerinden biri olmaya devam edeceğini ifade eden Ersan, yüksek borçlanma maliyetlerinin ekonomilerin önündeki en önemli engellerden biri olacağını vurguladı. Ersan, bu çerçevede, güçlü, güvenilir, etik değerlere ve sağlam bir stratejiye sahip, uzun vadeli yol arkadaşlığı yapılabilecek iş ortaklarıyla çalışmanın önemine dikkati çekti. Büyük projelere ve yatırımlara temkinli yaklaşılması, mevcut kazanımların ve finansal istikrarın korunması gerektiğini belirten Ersan, sağlıklı nakit akışı yönetiminin ve nitelikli insan kaynağını elde tutmanın şirketlerin sürdürülebilirliği açısından önemli olduğunu aktardı. Ersan, iş süreçlerine yapay zekanın entegre edilerek veri odaklı karar alma mekanizmalarının güçlendirilmesini de önererek, şirketlerin ciro büyümesi dışında karlılığa ve pazar penetrasyonunu artırmaya da odaklanmaları gerektiğinin altını çizdi. Bilkent Üniversitesi Öğretim Üyesi Prof. Dr. Hakan Kara’nın sunumuyla devam eden etkinlik, gala yemeği ve Alya’nın konseriyle sona erdi.

Şirket yöneticileri, 2027'de jeopolitik risklerin ve yüksek borçlanma maliyetlerinin etkisini sürdüreceği öngörüsünü paylaştı. Şirket, 2027 yılında enerji piyasasını bekleyen gelişmelere ilişkin öngörülerini de iş ortaklarıyla paylaştı.
