items.titleTr: Israel's new parliament to be sworn in as leaders compete to form government
items.summaryTr: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.
items.articleText: Israel's new parliament to be sworn in as leaders compete to form government - Published Israel's new parliament will be sworn in on Tuesday, as opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot seeks to oust caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The former army chief was tasked with forming a government by the president, after he received the backing of 67 members of the 120-seat Knesset, compared to 46 for Netanyahu. But Eisenkot faces an uphill struggle. His bloc of four parties won 48 seats in last month's election, while Netanyahu's bloc won 53, leaving both short of a majority. He has 28 days to build a coalition, with a possible two-week extension. Almost half of the MKs being sworn in did not serve in the previous parliament, while Arab-led parties have a record number of seats. The outcome of the election, which was widely seen as a referendum on Netanyahu, means there is a period of uncertainty over who will form the next government. Netanyahu will remain caretaker prime minister until then - a process which could take from days to months. One of the most dramatic results was the performance of Israel's two Arab-led alliances - the United Arab List and the Joint List - which won an unprecedented 19 seats between them following a surge in turnout among Arab voters. The Arab parties could therefore hold the balance of power, although Netanyahu has ruled out governing with them and three of the parties in Eisenkot's bloc have opposed including them in a coalition. On Sunday, President Isaac Herzog tasked Eisenkot with trying to form a government. Speaking at the president's residence, the centrist Yashar party leader called for the formation of a "national emergency government" - an implicit appeal to parties to put ideological differences aside to remove Netanyahu from office. This, he said, would "require creative and unconventional political steps". Eisenkot said any party or MK prepared to accept four principles could join his proposed government. Those are recognition of Israel as a Jewish and democratic state; accepting the values of the Declaration of Independence; backing mandatory military, national or civilian service for all, including communities currently exempt; and recognising Hamas as a terrorist organisation and committing to dismantling its military and governing capabilities. The four requirements, however, could present significant obstacles to Eisenkot's potential partners. The conscription of ultra-Orthodox Jewish men, who are exempt from military service if they are in full-time religious study, was a major election issue. The ultra-Orthodox United Torah Judaism (UTJ) and Shas parties, which won 13 seats in total, have fiercely objected to attempts to change the status quo - something that all parties in Eisenkot's bloc campaigned to do. Eisenkot's four principles are also contentious for the Arab parties. Both emphasise equal national and civic rights for Israel's Arab citizens, who form about 20% of the population; the vast majority of Israeli Arabs are not required to serve in the military; and neither has publicly recognised Hamas as a terrorist organisation. The Arab parties could, though, help Eisenkot form a minority government. The United Arab List, which won eight seats, has said it is willing to be part of an Eisenkot-led coalition, while the Joint List, which won 11 seats, has offered parliamentary support from the outside. If Eisenkot accepted such an arrangement, he would still have to persuade other parties in his bloc to agree. Avigdor Lieberman, whose Yisrael Beiteinu party won seven seats, has so far refused to join a minority government dependent on Arab MKs. In return for their support, the ultra-Orthodox parties would be likely to demand major concessions on military conscription, which might be unacceptable to most of the parties in Eisenkot's bloc. Netanyahu - Israel's longest-serving leader - reiterated in a video on Monday his call for the formation of a government of national unity, which he said he would lead as prime minister. He said any Zionist party - those which support Israel as a Jewish state - including opposition parties, would be eligible. He warned against a government which relied on what he called "the Islamists", an apparent reference to Arab parties. "You cannot form a government with Hamas supporters," he said. items.titleTr: Avrupa'ya elektrik taşımak için Türkiye dahil 4 ülke anlaştı: Temiz enerji koridoru kurulacak
items.summaryTr: Türkiye, Azerbaycan, Bulgaristan ve Gürcistan, temiz enerjinin Avrupa pazarlarına ulaştırılması amacıyla stratejik ortaklık anlaşması imzaladı. "Elektriğin TANAP'ı" olarak nitelendirilen projeyle dört ülkenin elektrik şebekelerinin entegrasyonu hedefleniyor.
items.articleText: Avrupa'ya elektrik taşımak için Türkiye dahil 4 ülke anlaştı: Temiz enerji koridoru kurulacak - Türkiye, Azerbaycan, Bulgaristan ve Gürcistan, temiz enerjinin Avrupa pazarlarına ulaştırılması amacıyla stratejik ortaklık anlaşması imzaladı. "Elektriğin TANAP'ı" olarak nitelendirilen projeyle dört ülkenin elektrik şebekelerinin entegrasyonu hedefleniyor. Türkiye, Azerbaycan, Bulgaristan ve Gürcistan arasında temiz enerji alanında stratejik ortaklığa ilişkin bir anlaşma imzalandı. Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Alparslan Bayraktar’ın imza koyduğu anlaşma ile bölgesel enerji arz güvenliğinin güçlendirilmesi, temiz enerji ticaretinin artırılması, enerji kaynaklarının çeşitlendirilmesi ve dört ülke arasında uzun vadeli stratejik enerji ortaklığının geliştirilmesi amaçlanıyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Alparslan Bayraktar, anlaşmaya ilişkin, “‘Elektriğin TANAP’ı’ olarak nitelendirdiğimiz bu projeyle, temiz enerji kaynaklarından üretilen elektriğin Azerbaycan-Gürcistan-Türkiye-Bulgaristan güzergâhı üzerinden Avrupa pazarlarına ulaştırılmasını hedefliyoruz. Elektrikleşmenin hız kazandığı bir dönemde attığımız bu adım; ülkelerimiz arasındaki enerji bağlarını güçlendirecek, temiz enerji ticaretine yeni imkânlar sunacak ve Avrupa’nın arz güvenliğine katkı sağlayacaktır.” dedi. Antalya’da düzenlenen BM İklim Değişikliği Çerçeve Sözleşmesi 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31), enerji alanında önemli bir anlaşmaya ev sahipliği yaptı. Stratejik ortaklık Türkiye, Azerbaycan, Bulgaristan ve Gürcistan arasında temiz enerji başta olmak üzere enerji sektöründeki iş birliğinin güçlendirilmesi ve bölgesel enerji bağlantısallığının geliştirilmesi amacıyla “Temiz Enerji Alanında Stratejik Ortaklığa İlişkin Anlaşma” imzalandı. Bakan Bayraktar imzaladı Anlaşmaya Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Alparslan Bayraktar’ın yanı sıra Azerbaycan Enerji Bakanı Parviz Şahbazov, Bulgaristan Enerji Bakanı Iva Petrova, Gürcistan Başbakan Yardımcısı ve Ekonomi ve Sürdürülebilir Kalkınma Bakanı Mariam Kvrivishvili imza koydu. Elektrik şebekeleri arasında entegrasyon Anlaşma kapsamında, temiz enerji kaynaklarından üretilen elektriğin sınır ötesi iletimi, dağıtımı ve ticaretinin geliştirilmesi, ülkeler arasında güvenli, güvenilir ve kesintisiz elektrik iletiminin sağlanmasına yönelik teknik, ticari ve düzenleyici koşulların oluşturulması ve elektrik şebekeleri arasındaki entegrasyonun desteklenmesi hedefleniyor. Fiber optik kablolar üzerinden veri aktarımı Ayrıca, proje kapsamında enerji hizmetlerinin sunulmasını desteklemek amacıyla fiber optik kablolar üzerinden iletişim ve veri aktarımının geliştirilmesi öngörülüyor. Temiz enerji ticareti artırılacak Anlaşma ile bölgesel enerji arz güvenliğinin güçlendirilmesi, temiz enerji ticaretinin artırılması, enerji kaynaklarının çeşitlendirilmesi ve dört ülke arasında uzun vadeli stratejik enerji ortaklığının geliştirilmesi de amaçlanıyor. Elektriğin TANAP’ı Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Alparslan Bayraktar, imzalanan anlaşmaya ilişkin sosyal medya hesaplarından bir açıklama yaptı. Türkiye’nin ev sahipliğinde düzenlenen COP31’in dört ülkeyi temiz enerjide ortak bir vizyon etrafında buluşturan stratejik bir ortaklığa sahne olduğunu ifade eden Bakan Bayraktar, “Antalya’da Türkiye, Azerbaycan, Bulgaristan ve Gürcistan hükümetleri arasında Temiz Enerji Alanında Stratejik Ortaklığa İlişkin Anlaşma'yı imza altına aldık. 2024'te temellerini attığımız ve Nisan 2025’te Bakü’de imzaladığımız mutabakat zaptıyla ilerlettiğimiz iş birliğimizi, bugün hükümetlerarası bir anlaşmayla daha güçlü bir zemine taşımış olduk. ‘Elektriğin TANAP’ı’ olarak nitelendirdiğimiz bu projeyle, temiz enerji kaynaklarından üretilen elektriğin Azerbaycan-Gürcistan-Türkiye-Bulgaristan güzergâhı üzerinden Avrupa pazarlarına ulaştırılmasını hedefliyoruz.” dedi. Avrupa’nın arz güvenliğine katkı sağlayacak Bakan Bayraktar, “Elektrikleşmenin hız kazandığı bir dönemde attığımız bu adım; ülkelerimiz arasındaki enerji bağlarını güçlendirecek, temiz enerji ticaretine yeni imkânlar sunacak ve Avrupa’nın arz güvenliğine katkı sağlayacaktır. Dört ülkenin ortak iradesini yansıtan anlaşmanın ülkelerimiz ve bölgemiz için hayırlı olmasını diliyorum.” ifadelerini de kullandı.

Türkiye’nin ev sahipliğinde düzenlenen COP31’in dört ülkeyi temiz enerjide ortak bir vizyon etrafında buluşturan stratejik bir ortaklığa sahne olduğunu ifade eden Bakan Bayraktar, “Antalya’da Türkiye, Azerbaycan, Bulgaristan ve Gürcistan hükümetleri arasında Temiz Enerji Alanında Stratejik Ortaklığa İlişkin Anlaşma'yı imza altına aldık. 2024'te temellerini attığımız ve Nisan 2025’te Bakü’de imzaladığımız mutabakat zaptıyla ilerlettiğimiz iş birliğimizi, bugün hükümetlerarası bir anlaşmayla daha güçlü bir zemine taşımış olduk. ‘Elektriğin TANAP’ı’ olarak nitelendirdiğimiz bu projeyle, temiz enerji kaynaklarından üretilen elektriğin Azerbaycan-Gürcistan-Türkiye-Bulgaristan güzergâhı üzerinden Avrupa pazarlarına ulaştırılmasını hedefliyoruz.” dedi. Avrupa’nın arz güvenliğine katkı sağlayacak Bakan Bayraktar, “Elektrikleşmenin hız kazandığı bir dönemde attığımız bu adım; ülkelerimiz arasındaki enerji bağlarını güçlendirecek, temiz enerji ticaretine yeni imkânlar sunacak ve Avrupa’nın arz güvenliğine katkı sağlayacaktır. Dört ülkenin ortak iradesini yansıtan anlaşmanın ülkelerimiz ve bölgemiz için hayırlı olmasını diliyorum.” ifadelerini de kullandı.

items.articleText: Nvidia CEO'sunun olası boşanması hesaplandı: Mal paylaşımı yeni rekor getirebilir! Nvidia CEO’su Jensen Huang’ın evlilik dışı ilişkisini kabul etmesinin ardından, eşi Lori Huang’ın olası bir boşanmada ne kadar servet elde edebileceği tartışılmaya başlandı. Forbes’un hesaplamalarına göre, eş Huang yakın dönemde gerçekleşen diğer milyarder boşanmalarındaki anlaşmaları bile aşabilir. Jensen Huang’ın serveti 155,4 milyar dolar Forbes Gerçek Zamanlı Milyarderler Listesi’ne göre Jensen Huang, 10 Kasım itibarıyla yaklaşık 155,4 milyar dolarlık servetiyle dünyanın en zengin 10 kişisi arasında yer alıyor. Nvidia hisselerinde yaşanan sert düşüş nedeniyle Huang, 9 Kasım Pazartesi günü kısa süreliğine ilk 10'un dışına çıktı. Huang’ın Nvidia’daki payı yüzde 3,5’in üzerinde bulunuyor. Bu oran, onu şirketin en büyük hissedarı konumuna getiriyor. Olası bir boşanma halinde Nvidia hisselerinin de mal paylaşımının parçası olup olmayacağı gündeme gelebilir. Huang, evlilik dışı ilişkisini kabul etti Nvidia CEO’su, Çin vatandaşı Alice Huang ile ilişki yaşadığına ilişkin haberlerin ardından pazar günü çalışanlarına gönderdiği açıklamada, eşine sadık kalmadığını kabul etti. Söz konusu haberlerde, ABD’de Çinli bir ajan olduğu iddia edilen Alice Huang’ın Çin hükümeti adına çalışan bir unsur olabileceğine ilişkin değerlendirmelere yer verilmişti. Jensen Huang, açıklamasında ilişkisinin eşini ve çocuklarını incittiğini belirterek, yaşananların sorumluluğunu üstlendiğini söyledi. Eşinden ve ailesinden özür dileyen Huang, “Bir özrün yaptıklarımı geri alamayacağını biliyorum” ifadesini kullandı. Ailesinin yeniden iyileşmesini ve zaman içinde güvenlerini yeniden kazanmayı umduğunu da dile getirdi. Lori Huang ise eşinin açıklamasının ardından evlilik dışı ilişki hakkında henüz kamuoyuna konuşmadı. Evliliği sürdürmek isteyip istemediğine ilişkin de herhangi bir açıklama yapmadı. Çift 1980’lerin ortasından bu yana evli Jensen ve Lori Huang, 1980’lerin ortalarında, Oregon State Üniversitesi’nde öğrenciyken tanıştı. Çift, Jensen Huang’ın Nvidia’yı kurmasından çok önce evlendi. Huang, daha önce yaptığı açıklamalarda eşinin Nvidia’nın kuruluşundan itibaren şirketin her aşamasında yanında olduğunu belirtmişti. Wall Street Journal’ın pazar günü yayımladığı habere göre Huang, yakın çalışma arkadaşlarına eşinin kendisi için her şeyi yaptığını, evrakları imzaladığını ve mali işlerini yönettiğini söyledi. Huang’ın kendi ev adresini bilmediğini ve faturalarını kendisinin ödemediğini esprili bir dille anlatması da haberde yer aldı. Nvidia hisselerinin mülkiyet yapısı paylaşımı etkileyebilir Nvidia’nın 2026 yılı vekaletname bildirimine göre Jensen Huang’a atfedilen hisselerin önemli bir bölümü, çiftin ortak mütevelli olduğu vakıf ve tröstlerde tutuluyor. Bu yapı nedeniyle her iki eşin de söz konusu hisseler üzerinde ortak ekonomik menfaate sahip olduğu belirtiliyor. Bununla birlikte, çiftin evlenmeden önce evlilik sözleşmesi veya evlilik sonrasında mal varlığının paylaşımını düzenleyen başka bir anlaşma imzalayıp imzalamadığı bilinmiyor. Böyle bir anlaşma, belirli varlıkların ortak mülkiyet yerine eşlerden birinin kişisel malı olarak kalmasını sağlayabilir. California’da evlilik süresince edinilen varlıklar yarı yarıya paylaşılabiliyor ABD’de California, edinilmiş malların eşit paylaşımını esas alan eyaletler arasında bulunuyor. Bu kurala göre evlilik süresince elde edilen varlıklar, açıkça eşlerden birinin kişisel mülkiyetinde tutulmadığı sürece boşanma sırasında eşit olarak paylaştırılıyor. Jensen Huang’ın Nvidia hisseleri ve şirketten elde ettiği gelirler de bu kapsamda değerlendirilebilir. Dolayısıyla olası bir boşanmada Lori Huang’ın eşinin servetinin yarısına hak kazanması gündeme gelebilir. Forbes’un hesaplamasına göre, bu senaryoda Lori Huang’ın elde edebileceği tutar en az 75 milyar dolar olabilir. Ancak nihai paylaşım, çiftin imzaladığı olası anlaşmaların içeriğine ve Jensen Huang’ın bazı varlıkların yalnızca kendi mülkiyetinde olduğunu kanıtlayıp kanıtlayamayacağına bağlı olacak. Lori Huang 12 haneli servetin yarısını alırsa Milyarderlerin boşanmalarında ortaya çıkan servet transferleri, Huang çifti açısından olası paylaşımın büyüklüğünü değerlendirmek için emsal oluşturuyor. Amazon’un kurucusu Jeff Bezos’dan boşanan MacKenzie Scott, ayrılık anlaşması kapsamında yaklaşık 36 milyar dolar değerindeki Amazon hisselerini aldı. Bill Gates ile Melinda French Gates’in 2021 yılında gerçekleşen boşanmasının mali ayrıntılarının tamamı kamuoyuna açıklanmadı. Bununla birlikte Melinda French Gates, eski eşinden milyarlarca dolarlık varlık elde etti. Bu transferler arasında yalnızca kişisel hayırseverlik faaliyetlerinde kullanılmak üzere sağlanan en az 12,5 milyar dolarlık destek ve boşanmanın ardından geçen yıllarda devredilen milyarlarca dolar değerindeki hisseler de bulunuyor. Lori Huang, eşinin 12 haneli servetinin yarısını alırsa bu miktar, yakın dönemde gerçekleşen diğer milyarder boşanmalarındaki anlaşmaları bile aşabilir.

items.articleText: Telefon alacaklar dikkat! Yeni modellerde kullanılmış RAM dönemi başlayabilir - Bellek çiplerindeki fiyat artışı ve tedarik sıkıntısı, akıllı telefon üreticilerini kullanılmış RAM bileşenlerine yöneltiyor. - Yeniden işlenen bellek modüllerinin 2027'de akıllı telefon pazarındaki payının yüzde 9'a ulaşabileceği tahmin ediliyor. Akıllı telefon sektöründe artan bellek maliyetleri üreticileri alternatif çözümler aramaya yöneltti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TrendForce'un raporuna göre bazı markalar, özellikle giriş seviyesi modellerinde daha önce kullanılmış ve yeniden işlenmiş RAM bileşenlerini değerlendirmeye başladı. "Reballing" olarak adlandırılan yöntemde, eski cihazlardan çıkarılan bellek modüllerinin lehim bağlantıları yenilenerek başka cihazlarda kullanılabilir hale getiriliyor. Bu yöntemle elde edilen bellekler, yeni bileşenlere kıyasla daha düşük maliyetli bir seçenek sunuyor. Yeniden işlenmiş RAM'lerin payı artabilir TrendForce'a göre piyasadaki yeniden işlenmiş belleklerin büyük bölümünü 4 GB kapasiteli LPDDR4X modüller oluşturuyor. Bu bileşenler özellikle giriş seviyesi 4G akıllı telefonlar için uygun görülüyor. Ancak DRAM fiyatlarındaki yükselişin sürmesi ve stok sıkıntısının kısa vadede çözülmesinin beklenmemesi, bu bileşenlerin daha üst segment cihazlarda da kullanılmasının önünü açabilir. TrendForce, yeniden işlenmiş belleklerin 2026'da mobil RAM pazarının yüzde 3-4'ünü oluşturacağını tahmin ediyor. Bu oranın 2027'de yüzde 7-9 seviyesine çıkabileceği öngörülüyor. Bellek krizinin daha da derinleşmesi bekleniyor Bellek sektöründeki sıkıntıların yakın zamanda sona ermesi beklenmiyor. Tayvan merkezli donanım şirketi TeamGroup'un Üst Yöneticisi Chen Ching-wen, bellek krizinin en kötü döneminin henüz yaşanmadığını ve fiyatların önümüzdeki aylarda yükselmeyi sürdürebileceğini belirtiyor. Chen, ilerleyen dönemde sorunun yalnızca fiyat artışından ibaret kalmayabileceğine, yüksek ödeme gücüne sahip alıcıların bile yeterli bellek bulmakta zorlanabileceğine dikkat çekiyor. TechSpot'ta yer alan habere göre Güney Koreli çip üreticisi SK Hynix de üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarında benzer bir tabloya işaret etti. Şirket, yapay zeka bağlantılı ürünlere yönelik talebin yavaşlamadığını ve bellek pazarındaki büyümenin orta ve uzun vadede devam etmesini beklediğini açıkladı. Yeniden işlenmiş RAM kullanımının yaygınlaşması, akıllı telefon üreticilerinin maliyetlerini kontrol altında tutmasına yardımcı olabilir. Ancak bu bileşenlerin daha geniş ürün gruplarına taşınması, cihazlarda kullanılan belleklerin kaynağı ve kalite kontrol süreçlerine ilişkin tartışmaları da beraberinde getirebilir.

Chen, ilerleyen dönemde sorunun yalnızca fiyat artışından ibaret kalmayabileceğine, yüksek ödeme gücüne sahip alıcıların bile yeterli bellek bulmakta zorlanabileceğine dikkat çekiyor. TechSpot'ta yer alan habere göre Güney Koreli çip üreticisi SK Hynix de üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarında benzer bir tabloya işaret etti. Şirket, yapay zeka bağlantılı ürünlere yönelik talebin yavaşlamadığını ve bellek pazarındaki büyümenin orta ve uzun vadede devam etmesini beklediğini açıkladı. Yeniden işlenmiş RAM kullanımının yaygınlaşması, akıllı telefon üreticilerinin maliyetlerini kontrol altında tutmasına yardımcı olabilir. Ancak bu bileşenlerin daha geniş ürün gruplarına taşınması, cihazlarda kullanılan belleklerin kaynağı ve kalite kontrol süreçlerine ilişkin tartışmaları da beraberinde getirebilir.

Sert düşüşün ardından yön değiştiren hisse, 8 işlem günü üst üste tavan yaparak 7,26 TL'ye yükseldi. Borsa İstanbul'da fon krizinin ardından bazı hisselerde yaşanan sert fiyat hareketleri yatırımcıların gündeminde yer almaya devam ediyor. Birlik Mensucat (BRMEN) hissesi de son aylarda yaşadığı keskin düşüşün ardından başlayan yükseliş serisiyle öne çıktı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 27 Temmuz 2026 tarihinde 20 TL ile en yüksek seviyesini gören BRMEN, takip eden aylarda satış baskısı altında kaldı. Hisse, 28 Ekim 2026 tarihinde 3,40 TL'ye kadar gerileyerek zirvesinden yüzde 83 değer kaybetti. Ancak bu seviyenin ardından hissede dikkat çekici bir yön değişimi yaşandı. BRMEN, 8 işlem günü üst üste tavan fiyat seviyesine ulaşarak 7,26 TL'ye yükseldi. Dip seviyeden yüzde 113 yükseldi 28 Ekim'de görülen 3,40 TL'lik dip ile güncel 7,26 TL fiyat karşılaştırıldığında hissedeki yükseliş yüzde 113,5'e ulaştı. Böylece BRMEN, kısa sürede değerini iki katından fazla artırmış oldu. Buna karşın son yükseliş serisine rağmen hisse, 27 Temmuz'da gördüğü 20 TL'lik zirvenin yaklaşık yüzde 63,7 altında işlem görüyor.

items.title: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures
items.summary: Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures
items.summaryTr: Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks.
items.articleText: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks. Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies asked a federal court Monday to accept a brief backing the United States Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) in a lawsuit over perpetual futures tied to individual US stocks. According to a proposed amicus brief shared Monday by Coinbase legal representative Molly Abraham, the group also includes Kraken parent Payward, trading companies DRW Holdings and Jump Trading, and crypto investment company Paradigm Operations. The companies argue that stock perpetual futures fall under existing US futures laws. The filing comes days after a federal judge found that the CFTC likely “exceeded its statutory authority” in allowing single-stock perpetuals to trade as security futures. The case could determine whether US exchanges can offer retail traders contracts that track individual stocks without expiring. Why stock perps face scrutiny On Nov. 3, the CFTC announced that single-stock perpetual futures, or stock perps, could begin trading on US-regulated exchanges for the first time. The Capital Markets Alliance Association (CMAA), a newly formed trade and advocacy group representing traditional financial market participants and whose members include Cboe and Citadel Securities, sued the CFTC last week, challenging the CFTC’s authority to allow the contracts to trade. Stock perps allow traders to speculate on the price movements of individual stocks without owning the shares. Unlike traditional futures, they have no fixed expiration date. The CMAA argues that because the contracts lack a fixed expiration date, they should be regulated as security-based swaps, a type of derivative linked to stocks or other securities that is primarily overseen by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and faces tighter restrictions on retail trading. The six companies backing the CFTC disagree, arguing that a fixed expiration date is not required for a contract to qualify as a security future, which falls under joint CFTC and SEC oversight. Related: Coinbase’s US national trust bank charter takes effect Judge questions CFTC authority but doesn’t halt trading Following the CMAA’s complaint, US District Judge Valerie Caproni said the plaintiff was likely to succeed in its claim that the CFTC exceeded its statutory authority by allowing stock perps to trade as security futures. Caproni found that the contracts appeared to qualify as swaps rather than security futures, casting doubt on the agency’s legal interpretation. However, she denied CMAA’s request for a temporary restraining order, finding that the group had failed to demonstrate imminent, irreparable harm. The decision left the CFTC’s trading approvals in place while the lawsuit proceeds. CMAA is scheduled to file its reply to the CFTC’s opposition to a preliminary injunction on Tuesday. Magazine: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act

items.title: Sales of tinned food and bottled water jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
items.summary: Sales of essential goods such as hand sanitiser soar after the government called on households to be prepared for emergencies.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Sales of tinned food and bottled water jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
items.summaryTr: Sales of essential goods such as hand sanitiser soar after the government called on households to be prepared for emergencies.
items.articleText: Sales of tinned food and bottled water jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch - Published Sales of essential goods such as bottled water and canned food soared in the 10 days following the launch of the government's "Be Ready" emergency preparedness campaign on 22 October, research indicates. Hand sanitiser sales were up 83%, sales of bottled water rose 67% and tinned and jarred goods climbed 37%, according to data from retail research firm Worldpanel by Numerator. The government's public awareness campaign encouraged people to stock up in case of disruption to essential services by severe weather or cyberattacks. However, Worldpanel said that while households were stockpiling essentials, they were not panic buying. The government campaign encouraged people to keep three days-worth of food and water in their homes. Wet wipes, a torch and cash were also recommended. After the campaign launch, the equivalent of an extra 400,000 people per day bought tinned meat, Worldpanel said, although the typical amount remained at 500g, which suggests a gradual stocking-up. "Shoppers clearly took notice of the 'Be Ready' campaign, but this wasn't panic buying, with less than a third of households buying bottled water in October," said Fraser McKevitt, head of retail and consumer insight at Worldpanel by Numerator. "Growth came from more people adding the recommended items on the government's checklist to their weekly shop, not from shoppers piling their trolleys high, which is very much in line with what the government wanted households to do," he said. Further evidence of stockpiling came from food firm Princes on Tuesday, which said demand for tinned tuna, meat and vegetables had risen following the government's campaign. Princes interim chief executive Giuseppe Mastrolia said the jump in demand "further reinforces the relevance of our core categories in providing affordable, nutritious and convenient food solutions". The "Be Ready" campaign warns that severe weather and cyber attacks could disrupt essential services, and British households need to make sure they have what they need - for example, bottled water, and long-life food that doesn't need to be kept in the fridge such as dried fruit and nuts. Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said everyone should have "those supplies in the house to get you through those moments". Get in touch Have you been stockpiling? If so, what have you been buying? - Published23 October

items.title: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys
items.summary: The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys
items.summaryTr: The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw.
items.articleText: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw. Update (Nov. 10, 2026, 12:14 pm UTC): This article has been updated to include a response from a Binance spokesperson. Cryptocurrency exchange Binance warned Tuesday that an iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet recovery phrases and private keys if a user runs a malicious app on an affected iPhone. Binance listed iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2 among the affected versions that could allow malicious apps to read local files from other apps, putting seed phrases, private keys and login credentials “at risk across the entire ecosystem.” Binance added that this was “an iOS-level issue, not unique to Binance.” Binance urged users to delete any apps installed from untrusted sources, update iOS and all apps to the latest official versions, and transfer funds to new wallets created on clean devices if they suspect a breach already occurred. Blockchain security firm SlowMist flagged the issue earlier on Tuesday, saying a malicious app could read recovery phrases if a wallet stores them unencrypted on the device. An iOS security researcher who goes by forcequitOS publicly disclosed the flaw on Sunday and credited another researcher who goes by 0xjohnny. Apple released iOS 27.2.1 and 26.7.3 on Monday, but it remains unclear whether either update fixes the flaw. Cointelegraph contacted Apple about the vulnerability, but had not received a response by publication. A spokesperson for Binance told Cointelegraph that the “underlying file-access risk may apply across the iOS ecosystem” but said it identified no confirmed cases where attackers used this bug to access cryptocurrency wallets or steal funds. Related: Binance hackers move 81% of stolen Solana, route funds via THORChain

items.title: Police officer dies and another injured after backpack explosion in Oviedo
items.summary: Officers attended the scene in connection with a separate incident at a residential building in the city.

items.titleTr: Police officer dies and another injured after backpack explosion in Oviedo
items.summaryTr: Officers attended the scene in connection with a separate incident at a residential building in the city.
items.articleText: Police officer dies and another injured after backpack explosion in Oviedo - Published A police officer has died and another has been injured in the northern Spanish city of Oviedo after an explosive device went off at the scene of a shooting. The blast happened when officers from Spain's canine unit and explosives disposal unit arrived and examined a suspicious backpack following reports of a dispute between neighbours on Tuesday morning. A woman who had been shot and the injured officer have been taken to hospital for treatment. The suspect fled the scene and is still at large, police said. Spanish police paid tribute to the dead officer, who has been named as Juan José, in a statement on X and said: "Our hearts are with his family, friends, colleagues and loved ones." Officers attended the scene early after receiving reports of an argument between neighbours and upon arriving found a woman who had sustained gunshot wounds, police spokesman Pedro Aguado said. While searching for the suspected attacker, officers found a suspicious backpack with a flashing light and contacted both the bomb disposal unit and canine unit. "While the package was being moved outside to ensure the safety of the residents, an explosion occurred," Aguado added. The explosion left a member of the canine unit dead and an officer from the bomb disposal unit seriously injured, he said. A three-year-old police dog named Deny was also killed in the explosion. A widespread police operation is ongoing near the scene of the explosion and officers are continuing to hunt for the suspect. Taking to social media, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said he was "deeply shocked" by the fatal incident and paid tribute to the officer injured in the explosion. "Your dedication and courage deserve the gratitude of an entire country," he said. Spanish opposition leader and President of the People's Party Alberto Núñez Feijóo said: "What happened in Oviedo is heartbreaking. "My condolences to the family of the officer who died and my best wishes for the recovery of the one who was seriously injured. - Published3 days ago

items.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian boy in West Bank, health ministry says
items.summary: The Israeli military says its soldiers opened fire at individuals “who intended to hurl stones” at a road used by Israelis.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Israeli forces kill Palestinian boy in West Bank, health ministry says
items.summaryTr: The Israeli military says its soldiers opened fire at individuals “who intended to hurl stones” at a road used by Israelis.
items.articleText: Israeli forces kill Palestinian boy in West Bank, health ministry says - Published Israeli forces have shot dead a 14-year-old Palestinian boy during an operation in the occupied West Bank, Palestinian officials say. Moataz Daghlas was killed on Monday evening in the village of Burqa, north-west of Nablus, according to the Palestinian health ministry. The Israeli military said soldiers identified "several terrorists who intended to hurl stones" in an area where stones had previously been thrown at Israeli vehicles. The soldiers fired towards them "to remove the threat", it added. The Palestinian Red Crescent said its teams treated two people with gunshot wounds, but that Israeli forces blocked their access to a third wounded person and detained three volunteer paramedics. Moataz Daghlas's relatives said Israeli authorities were withholding his body. Meanwhile, Palestinian news agency Wafa identified the two Palestinians wounded during the raid as a 17-year-old child, who it said was shot in the abdomen and pelvis, and a 19-year-old man, who was shot in the hand. According to the UN, at least 98 Palestinians, including 22 children, have been killed by Israeli forces or settlers in the West Bank since the start of the year. Six Israelis, both security forces and civilians, have been killed by Palestinians in the West Bank over the same period, it says. The rules of engagement for Israeli forces were reportedly broadened after the deadly Hamas-led attacks on Israel on 7 October 2023, allowing soldiers increased discretion to use lethal force against a perceived threat. In June, the UN Human Rights Office in the occupied Palestinian territory said it had verified the killing of 241 Palestinian children by Israeli security forces and settlers in the West Bank since then. Most of the children were teenage boys and, in many cases, Israeli authorities accused them of having engaged in stone-throwing as justification, it found. The UN office said its assessment was that none of the children killed while involved in confrontations with Israeli forces had posed an imminent threat to life, which it said was the only legal justification for the use of lethal force in the West Bank under international law. - Published25 October

According to the UN, at least 98 Palestinians, including 22 children, have been killed by Israeli forces or settlers in the West Bank since the start of the year. Six Israelis, both security forces and civilians, have been killed by Palestinians in the West Bank over the same period, it says. The rules of engagement for Israeli forces were reportedly broadened after the deadly Hamas-led attacks on Israel on 7 October 2023, allowing soldiers increased discretion to use lethal force against a perceived threat. In June, the UN Human Rights Office in the occupied Palestinian territory said it had verified the killing of 241 Palestinian children by Israeli security forces and settlers in the West Bank since then. Most of the children were teenage boys and, in many cases, Israeli authorities accused them of having engaged in stone-throwing as justification, it found. The UN office said its assessment was that none of the children killed while involved in confrontations with Israeli forces had posed an imminent threat to life, which it said was the only legal justification for the use of lethal force in the West Bank under international law. - Published25 October

items.titleTr: Ex-employee sues Ethereum Foundation and Vitalik Buterin over firing
items.summaryTr: Kayleen Fulton alleges she was fired less than two weeks after disclosing a cancer diagnosis and helping organize a staff letter challenging a requirement to endorse the foundation’s new mandate.
items.articleText: Ex-employee sues Ethereum Foundation and Vitalik Buterin over firing Kayleen Fulton alleges she was fired less than two weeks after disclosing a cancer diagnosis and helping organize a staff letter challenging a requirement to endorse the foundation’s new mandate. A former Ethereum Foundation employee has sued the organization, along with Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin and four others. Kayleen Fulton alleges she was fired after disclosing a cancer diagnosis and organizing a staff letter challenging a directive tied to the foundation’s new mandate. Fulton, who led the foundation’s protocol support team and is known in the Ethereum community as “Nixo,” filed the complaint on Nov. 4 in the United States District Court for the District of Colorado. She alleges that Bastian Aue, a co-executive director at the time, fired her on April 6, 13 days after she disclosed her diagnosis. The complaint also alleges Buterin helped adopt and enforce the directive as a board member. Fulton said she and colleague Trent Van Epps organized a letter in response to the mandate with 53 signers. It backed the mandate’s goals while objecting to a requirement that employees affirm it to keep their jobs. The complaint alleges that days later, on April 6, Aue fired Fulton and Van Epps 30 minutes apart. Fulton alleges disability discrimination, retaliation and interference with her medical leave rights and is seeking lost pay and damages. The complaint also says some employees objected to a reference to ritual suicide in the mandate and quotes Aue as telling staff that the language was figurative. In a May 14 letter quoted in the complaint, a lawyer for the foundation’s Singapore affiliate, Ethereum Asia Pacific Limited, denied that Fulton had been subjected to unlawful conduct or retaliation and said her separation agreement was binding. Cointelegraph reached out to the foundation, Fulton and Van Epps for comment, but had not received a response by publication. The foundation published its mandate in March, charting out its role in Ethereum’s ongoing and future development. It highlighted censorship resistance, open-source code, privacy and security, and said it would focus on protocol upgrades, research and developer tools. Magazine: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest

items.titleTr: Bitcoin price eyes $74K as Fed rate-hike bets hit 96% after Waller speech
items.summaryTr: Bitcoin price action and stock futures trended lower after Fed governor Christopher Waller said that he would vote to raise interest rates by 0.25% at the December FOMC meeting.
items.articleText: Bitcoin price eyes $74K as Fed rate-hike bets hit 96% after Waller speech Bitcoin price action and stock futures trended lower after Fed governor Christopher Waller said that he would vote to raise interest rates by 0.25% at the December FOMC meeting. Bitcoin (BTC) fell toward $74,000, and US stock futures dropped on Tuesday as a senior Federal Reserve official voiced support for hiking interest rates. Key points: - Bitcoin traded 1.3% lower on Tuesday, reaching $74,080 as Nasdaq futures fell 0.4% ahead of the Wall Street open. - October US CPI data, due for release at 8.30am on Tuesday, is expected to show a monthly increase of 0.3%, less than September’s 0.6% gain. - Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller said that he would “support” a 0.25% interest-rate hike at the Dec. 9 FOMC meeting regardless of Tuesday’s CPI reading. Waller would “still support” December rate hike after lower CPI Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD reaching $74,080 on Bitstamp, down 1.3% on the day. BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView US stock market futures leaned lower as Fed governor Christopher Waller said that he would support hiking interest rates by 25 basis points at the next meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) on Dec. 9. At the time of writing, Nasdaq 100 futures were down 0.4%. His decision, he added, would not be swayed by lower-than-expected inflation data. The October prints of the US Consumer Price Index (CPI) is due for release at 8.30 am Eastern time on Tuesday. It is expected to show a month-on-month increase of 0.3% versus September when the increase was 0.6%, pushed higher by rising fuel costs. “While I am hoping for an improvement over September, even if this occurs, I would still support a 25 basis point increase in the FOMC’s policy rate at our December meeting,” Waller commented in a speech at the Bank of England Watchers Conference in London. “However, if inflation comes in substantially higher than I expect, more robust action by the FOMC may be called for.” US CPI 12-month % change. Source: BLS While CPI is particularly sensitive to fuel-price volatility, Waller also flagged high readings from the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) index, known to be the Fed’s “preferred” inflation gauge and which he confirmed was the “measure targeted by the FOMC.” “Let’s just say it. September’s inflation data were bad. There was no silver lining,” he said, referring to PCE rising 0.5% month-on-month and 3.7% year-on-year, respectively. Following the speech, markets immediately repriced odds of a 25-basis-point hike in December from 76.3% to 96.3%, per data from CME Group’s FedWatch Tool. Fed target-rate probability comparison for December FOMC meeting (screenshot). Source: CME Group 2025 government shutdown to limit market CPI cues Financial policy tightening measures traditionally act as headwinds for crypto and risk asset prices as they imply a reduction in liquidity and associated capital inflows. Related: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target Commenting on the impetus for the expected slowdown in CPI upside for October, Christopher Hodge, chief US economist at Natixis CIB Americas, pointed to price declines in both fuel and shelter. “We think the slowdown in core CPI will stem from a reversion of shelter prices, primarily owners’ equivalent rents and lodging away from home. Similarly, the stabilization in diesel prices should help to quell price pressures in energy-intensive goods,” he wrote, quoted by CNBC. The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), which publishes CPI, confirmed that Tuesday’s release would include only month-on-month statistics due to the 2025 US government shutdown reducing data availability. CPI data for October 2025 was not issued for the same reason.

items.articleText: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash - Published Kim Kardashian's Skims is offering customers refunds for its $148 (£110) advent calendar which has been widely criticised on social media. The accessories advent calendar promised "twelve days of fun surprises" but has been mocked online for the quality of its contents, such as hair clips and keychains, with some comparing them to something you would find down the back of a sofa. A spokesperson for Skims has told a number of media outlets "for some, the calendar didn't meet expectations" and the company has "personally contacted every customer" to offer a full refund or credit to put towards other products". The BBC has contacted Skims for comment. The shapewear and clothing business was co-founder by Kardashian in 2019 and has made the reality TV star a billionaire, according to Forbes magazine. Skims was valued at $5bn in 2025 when it raised millions of dollars in new funding. One account on TikTok called spicychathouse compared the contents of the calendar to things "my cat collects from around my house". Another account said it looked like "a bunch of stuff that Kim Kardashian was emptying out of her bedside table". A number of accounts showed people cleaning out their own sofas and claiming they had accidentally created the Skims advent calendar. What's in the Skim's advent calendar? Day 1: Tartan teddy bear key chain Day 2: Hair ties Day 3: Hair ties Day 4: Skims logo hair clips Day 5: Skims logo squishy ornament Day 6: Skims logo hair clips Day 7: Beige elastic straps/hair bands Day 8: Skims logo hair clips Day 9: Skims logo comb keychain Day 10: Hair ties Day 11: Skims keychain Day 12: Furry compact mirror keychain Get in touch What is the most money you’ve spent on an advent calendar, and was it worth it? items.summary: Households dependent on either heating oil or LPG and are eligible for reduced council tax will benefit.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Thousands of 'off-grid' homes eligible for £250 to help with heating bills
items.summaryTr: Households dependent on either heating oil or LPG and are eligible for reduced council tax will benefit.
items.articleText: Thousands of 'off-grid' homes eligible for £250 to help with heating bills - Published Up to 20,000 homes using heating oil could get a £250 payment from the Welsh government to help with the rising cost of living. The government said £5m from a new £130m package will help "off grid" households who are dependent on either heating oil or LPG and are eligible for reduced council tax. The package includes the £100 household energy payment, with this extended to those eligible for council tax relief "irrespective of band". It also includes £7m support for bus travel and £8m for councils to help those "not captured by other schemes". It follows the UK government unveiling a £100 "household energy payment" for council taxpayers in bands A-D in England in October. Wales' Deputy First Minister Sioned Williams said supporting families with the cost of living was a "key priority". "We understand that this is a challenging time for many households across Wales," she said. "In total this represents an additional investment of £130m, providing immediate relief for households this winter. While we are taking firm action wherever we can, we need the UK Government to play its part". Five million pounds of the package will help towards "off-grid" fuel costs with a £250 payment available to households eligible for Council Tax Reduction based on their incomes and are dependent on either heating oil or LPG. An additional £8m will allow councils to extend the £100 payment to households "not captured" by other schemes and are facing financial hardship. While £7m is being made available to support bus operators with their high fuel costs and protect passengers from fares increases. The Welsh government said with winter approaching and the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, "the coming months will be a challenging time for many". "This package represents a significant investment in Welsh communities and reflects our determination to stand alongside households during challenging times," it added. The Welsh government had already said it would make the £100 energy payment to about one million households in Wales following Chancellor John Healey's UK Budget announcement in October. The chancellor said council taxpayers in bands A-D in England would get the payment and urged the Welsh government to follow his lead, with Wales' Finance Minister Elin Jones subsequently saying households in the same bands in Wales would also benefit. Healey announced an end to gas standing charges but did not address call to help those people, mainly in rural areas, who relied on either heating oil or LPG. Related topics More top stories - Published1 day ago

items.title: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'
items.summary: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation change.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'
items.summaryTr: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation change.
items.articleText: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely' - Published Donald Trump has said "Iran militarily is effectively over", and said that there is "positive momentum" behind negotiations to end the Middle East conflict. "We're just keeping it the status quo," the US president said on Monday. "And we're doing that really at the behest of countries that are their neighbours." Trump's comments came after he met the Qatari prime minister. Qatar is a US ally in the Gulf region, and one of Iran's neighbours, which has been a key mediator in efforts to end the war. Addressing reporters in the White House press briefing room, Trump said that renewed US attacks on Iran were "highly unlikely" but that the US was "locked and loaded" should the circumstances change. Iranian officials have repeatedly expressed doubts about Trump's prior comments about resolving the conflict. This is not the first time that Trump has said the Iran war is "militarily" over, but the circumstances for him are different now. The president has hinted at de-escalation in Iran after a bruising set of midterm election results for the Republicans last week, which senior figures including Vice-President JD Vance blamed on the Iran war. Ahead of the midterms, Trump had said US forces conducted what he described as "minor strikes" on an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz. However, in an interview with 60 Minutes that aired on Sunday, the president said that he did not currently see "any reason" to escalate the conflict. Responding to a question over why he would not officially declare an end to the war, Trump said that some of the Gulf allies could still face Iranian aggression. "We have some great allies there and we have to make sure they're not hurt," he said, suggesting that the US naval blockade on Iranian ports was helping to make the region more secure. Global oil prices, which have fallen sharply since the midterms, dipped further after Trump's comments. On Tuesday afternoon in Asia, Brent crude was more than 1% lower at $91.50 (£52) while US-traded was down by 1.2% at $85.82. Trump hosted Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdul Rahman Al Thani in the Oval Office earlier on Monday, saying they had an "excellent conversation" about negotiations to end the war. In a post on X, the Qatari leader said he held "positive discussions" with Trump and Vance on "reaching a deal and bringing peace to the region". Efforts to broker a peace between Washington and Tehran have largely been held indirectly through mediators since the war first broke out following joint US-Israeli strikes in February. Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates are among the US's Gulf allies that have been hit by Iranian strikes over the course of the war, in addition to the threat of strikes that have led to major air travel disruptions in the region. Post-election recriminations over the US war in Iran are already placing pressure on members of the Trump administration. Republican congressman Thomas Massie launched a strong attack against Trump's Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Monday over the war in Iran, requesting a vote in the House of Representatives to impeach him. Trump has backed Hegseth, who says he is "not worried" about the looming impeachment threats, calling Massie's effort a "sham". While the move is unlikely to succeed with Republicans still in control of Congress until January, Democrats have expressed willingness to impeach Hegseth once the new session begins and they have control of both the House and the Senate. - Published12 hours ago - Published2 days ago

items.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
items.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
items.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
items.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
items.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
items.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
items.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

items.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
items.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

items.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
items.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-
